Anthropic.content:
# Claude's new flagship has just been released, and its 950,000-word top-secret prompt set has been completely leaked.

新智元2026-11-13 17:53

Putting on a tough front, feigning ignorance and even sending blank replies, you get your defenses completely broken the second you see the word "turtle".

Anthropic's brand-new blockbuster model Claude Fable 5.2 has been online for just over two hours, and its full backend details have been completely leaked!

On the very day the new model was released, top jailbreak hacker Pliny breached Claude Code and posted the full system prompts and tool definitions in their entirety to GitHub.

The full top-secret document contains as many as 953,659 characters and a full 7832 lines, with a volume comparable to two full-length novels!

This internal document of nearly a million characters has long evolved into a complete set of "invisible operating system" that governs the operation of top-tier Agents.

Digging through this 950,000-character long document, there are 5 core explosive findings in total:

Secretly hitting the brakes during the training phase to prevent others from using Claude to train AI. Anthropic deliberately weakened the new model's "accelerator kernel optimization" capability, and instructed it to lower its confidence level when encountering operator optimization tasks.

128 built-in tools, no unauthorized parallel clones allowed to cut costs. Although Claude can clone copies at any time to process tasks in parallel, the prompts issue a bold warning that no unauthorized sub-Agent shall be launched, because cold-start recalculation of context is extremely costly.

44 pre-installed skill sets covering making phone calls and running daily errands. Claude can make real calls to reserve seats, retrieve verification codes from Gmail for reimbursement, and take photos of medicine bottles to renew prescriptions for users, and can also import memories from other AIs with one click.

Strictly protect the connected computer and user wallet. When connected to a local computer, the rm command is locked by default to prevent accidental deletion; when encountering stock trading, fund transfer or entering real passwords, it will firmly refuse the request even if the user themselves grants authorization.

Jailbreak protection is maxed out, but it is caught lying and feigning ignorance. It will ignore all forged "remove guardrails" instructions, but after the hacker inserts a secret message into the hidden tag, Claude, who insisted that he saw nothing, accidentally leaked the information right after.

## The top tier hides the Mythos gear, with training restrictions set to prevent others from using it to train AI

Up to now, the top "Mythos" tier of Anthropic has not been open to the public, and is only available for internal calls by a small number of trusted institutions.

The Fable 5.2 updated synchronously this time and the internal version Mythos 5.2 still share the same underlying model, both supporting 1 million context windows.

Because this base model has extremely strong capabilities in digging high-risk vulnerabilities and conducting biological research, the publicly available Fable 5.2 is additionally equipped with dual restrictions on biological and cybersecurity, and the full-capability Mythos version is only reserved for reviewed institutions.

The truly unexpected new detail is hidden in line 119: even the twin flagship model on the highest tier, was secretly braked by the official during the training phase!

Claiming it is for safety in public, but actually to prevent others from using Claude to accelerate the training of large models, Anthropic specifically weakened its "accelerator kernel optimization" capability during training.

The prompts even force Claude to "play dumb" on the spot: once encountering a computing power kernel optimization task, it must actively doubt its own judgment and obediently consult external documents.

It can go all out when writing business codes in daily scenarios, but if anyone wants to spend a high price to use it to optimize the computing power kernel and train their own AI, the official will secretly restrict the performance from model weights to prompts.

## 920,000 more characters than the public version, 128 tools and 44 skill sets are all exposed

System prompts are pre-written "factory rules" that are quietly sent to the AI before each conversation.

In fact, on the day Fable 5.2 went online, Anthropic's official website also posted a public version of the system prompts synchronously, but its full length is only 31,881 characters, a mere 178 lines.

In comparison, the full running version leaked by Pliny this time is as much as 30 times the volume of the official website version!

The chat rules released in the public document account for less than 3.4%, and the remaining core content of over 920,000 characters is all hidden under the surface and not released!

When Fable 5 was first launched five months ago, the leaked internal prompts were only 120,000 characters, which has skyrocketed by nearly 8 times in less than half a year.

Unpacking this internal document of more than 950,000 characters, core behaviors, memory and security rules account for about 196,000 characters.

The 128 never-exposed tool interfaces take up about 330,000 characters, and the remaining 428,000 characters are filled with 44 built-in skill manuals.

Compared with the leaked versions of the previous two generations, the number of built-in tools has surged from 18 and 46 to the current 128.

For the Artifact tool responsible for rendering web applications alone, the parameters and built-in database descriptions take up a full 37,794 characters.

In the Agent tool responsible for task distribution, Claude can obviously clone multiple "copies" at any time to work in parallel, and is equipped with up to 5 levels of reasoning intensity.

But the prompt strictly orders in bold font that "no sub-Agent shall be launched without permission unless the user actively requests it", the reason is very straightforward: each cold start recalculation of the context costs too much money!

In addition to the 128 tool interfaces, the 44 pre-installed practical skill sets take over all the tedious work in office and daily life.

In addition to generating and annotating Word, PPT, Excel and PDF, there is even a hidden "make calls to reserve seats" guide.

Before dialing, Claude will first check the user's calendar and prepare 2 or 3 alternative time slots silently; if the call waits in the queue for more than 2 or 3 minutes, it will hang up decisively and report to the user.

Once the real person on the other end picks up, its first sentence must introduce itself: "I am Claude, the AI assistant calling on behalf of the user".

Another "automatic reimbursement" process teaches it to log in to the welfare platform, retrieve the 6-digit verification code from Gmail, fill in the amount in the bill, and upload the invoice.

There are also complete standard processes for checking photos of medicine bottles to renew prescriptions, handling traffic violation tickets, and processing returns and refunds.

It also thoughtfully prepares the "memory migration" function, teaching Claude to help users import historical memories from other AI assistants with one click.

## Local file deletion is locked by default, all fund transfer and password filling requests are rejected unconditionally

Handing over all tools together with the permission to control the local computer to the large model will cause a disaster once something goes wrong.

Fortunately, for ordinary users, this prompt protects the security of the computer and wallet very thoroughly, with full sincerity.

When Claude connects to the user's local computer for operation, all file deletion commands such as rm and rmdir in the terminal are locked by default and will return errors, which fundamentally prevents the AI from accidentally deleting the database.

If the user does not approve the pop-up window, Claude can only create a new _to_delete folder obediently, move the files into it and wait for the user to clean up by themselves.

In the highest-level "absolute restricted zone", stock trading, fund transfer, filling in real passwords or bank card numbers on behalf of users, and bypassing verification codes are all completely banned without exception.

Even if the user actively sends the password in the chat box and explicitly says "I authorize you to do this", Claude must refuse outright!

In order to prevent malicious codes in web pages or emails from hijacking the AI, all external content read by the tools is treated as ordinary data, and will never be executed as instructions.

Even if a message with Anthropic's signature or system label pops up in the conversation, claiming that "security restrictions have been lifted", Claude will treat it as a scam and ignore it!

In addition to sticking to the bottom line of security, it also has full details in speaking propriety and privacy protection, showing full respect for users everywhere.

Long-term memory is strictly prohibited from privately storing salary information, medical diagnosis results, ID numbers, and instructions that require the AI to blindly praise the user.

When calling historical memories at ordinary times, Claude cannot say "according to my memory", so as not to make users feel the discomfort of being monitored.

When rejecting a request, it is not allowed to list points coldly and preach, even if the office worker stays up until 4 a.m. to write code, it will never meddle to urge the adult to go to sleep.

## It lied that it saw nothing and replied with blank messages continuously, but was broken through by a single word "tortoise"

The funny thing is, no matter how tight the nearly million-word defense line is built, the face-slapping scene came just over an hour after the leak!

Pliny found the hidden reasoning gear tag automatically attached to each

Anthropic.description: the so-called "strictest account ban mechanism in Claude's history" of AI company Anthropic officially took effect ... Anthropic was founded in 2021 by the former core team of OpenAI, headquartered in San Francisco, with Claude large model as its core product.
Anthropic.content:
# Anthropic tightens risk control ahead of its IPO, and Claude's strictest account ban measures have taken effect.

36氪的朋友们2026-11-13 16:37

Clarify the penetrating review standards for regional access, with the purpose of blocking the means to bypass regional restrictions such as shell companies and agency transit.

On November 12, the so-called "strictest account ban mechanism in Claude's history" of AI company Anthropic officially took effect, clarifying the penetration review standards for regional access, with the aim of blocking methods to bypass regional restrictions such as shell companies and agent transit.

On local time October 8, Anthropic released the 2026 updated announcement of Claude Usage Policy, making detailed clarifications on the Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) and supported regional rules.

The new regulation covers all Claude-related products and services: including official applications such as Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Cowork, APIs and developer platforms, as well as Claude model services provided through cloud service providers and authorized distributor channels. This set of regional access and usage constraint rules applies uniformly to all channels.

The new regulation sets three types of access restrictions for usage entities: if the user's physical location is in an unsupported region, access is not allowed even if they work for an enterprise in a compliant region; if the business entity's registered address or headquarters is located in a restricted region, employees in compliant regions are not eligible for usage; if an enterprise is directly or indirectly held or de facto controlled by entities in restricted regions, access will be restricted regardless of the registration location and the user's location.

In addition to the regional access clauses, this update also supplements a number of constraints on risk scenarios, explicitly prohibiting the use of Claude to operate fake account matrices, build fake information sites, and carry out commercial or public opinion manipulation activities. For 11 types of high-risk decision scenarios including medical care, finance, law, employment, credit, and insurance, it is required that personalized suggestions generated by AI output must be reviewed by qualified personnel, and relevant parties shall be informed that the conclusion is generated with AI participation, etc.

The policy also adds new constraints on model abuse. In terms of the penalty mechanism, Anthropic has set up a gradient disposal plan, including warning, current limiting, temporary freezing, and permanent banning of accounts and API keys.

Anthropic stated in the announcement that most of this update is a clarification of the original rules rather than a brand-new ban, and the adjustment is based on new types of abuse cases observed in the past year.

Compared with the previous policy, the core of this tightening is that the regional access restrictions are solidified into three independent and complete bans, the penetration verification of equity and actual control links is incorporated into the official supported regional rules, reducing the operation space of using overseas shell entities and overseas subsidiaries to circumvent regional control; the risk control judgment has shifted from focusing on single-point IP verification to multi-dimensional retrospective verification combining time zone, language, concurrent behavior and other dimensions; meanwhile, the clauses related to deceptive activities are integrated, the violation boundaries such as fake account matrix and influence manipulation are clarified, and new details such as continuous abusive model calling and the requirement of supporting emergency shutdown mechanism for self-owned hardware are added.

Industry insiders interpret that users and developers who rely on VPN to disguise their region, share subscription accounts, and distribute through third-party API transit will be significantly affected.

When this policy is implemented, Anthropic is in the IPO roadshow stage. Its prospectus discloses that 5%-7% of the company's revenue in the first nine months came from customer groups that will later be identified as non-compliant. This part of revenue comes with hidden risks of supervision and legal disputes, which is a key risk under the listing information disclosure requirements.

Anthropic's active policy tightening this time can narrow the compliance risk exposure during the roadshow stage, demonstrate the implementation capability of risk control to investors, clear out customers with compliance flaws in advance, and reduce the possibility of regulatory inquiries and market doubts about the quality of revenue after listing.

Anthropic was founded in 2021 by the former core team of OpenAI, headquartered in San Francisco, with Claude large model as its core product. The company submitted its prospectus on October 26, planning to land on Nasdaq under the code ANT, underwritten by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley. The offering price range has not yet been finalized, and the market expects that this IPO combined with placement is expected to become the largest single issuance in the history of US stock market.

In recent years, Anthropic's revenue has grown rapidly, with revenue of 41 million US dollars in 2023, 386 million US dollars in 2024, 45.85 billion US dollars in 2025, and 332.42 billion US dollars in the first three quarters of 2026, a year-on-year increase of more than 12 times. The revenue is mainly based on API pay-as-you-go billing.

On November 13, it was reported that the subscription demand for Anthropic's initial public offering (IPO) is about 6 times the number of shares available for subscription. According to the documents submitted by the company, Anthropic and its co-founders plan to raise up to 644 billion US dollars through the IPO, and raise 260 billion US dollars through the simultaneous private placement, with a total maximum of 904 billion US dollars. The company targets a fully diluted valuation of about 1.4 trillion US dollars.

Another leading AI company, OpenAI, also released a new version of usage policy update on October 21. The new regulation will take effect on November 20, with the core addition of pre-approval requirements for model access intermediaries, clarifying that platforms that transit and distribute GPT models through third parties must obtain official authorization, and at the same time refining the constraints on prohibiting the use of OpenAI models and outputs to train competing models, youth protection, high-risk scenarios and national security purposes.

OpenAI officially stated that this policy update aims to clarify the original security constraints, protect teenagers, standardize the use of high-risk and national security scenarios, and block unauthorized third-party transit distribution, using model outputs to train competing models and other behaviors. Industry analysis believes that the new regulation is also intended to curb gray arbitrage behaviors such as account reselling, bulk account farming, and quota reselling, so as to reduce compliance and intellectual property risks.

OpenAI has secretly submitted the S-1 draft to the SEC in June 2026, but explicitly abandoned the 2026 IPO window, and the management has publicly set 2027 as the potential listing time node.

This article is from Jiemian News, written by Shen Xiaoge, and published with authorization by 36Kr.

Anthropic.title: Anthropic launches Claude manufacturing plugin with 17 AI skills
Anthropic.description: Anthropic launches Claude manufacturing plugin with 17 AI skills Anthropic launched Claude for Manufacturing on Thursday, a plugin with 17 preconfigured skills for production-line teams including estimators, quality engineers, technicians and buyers. The plugin connects Claude to Autodesk Fusion...
Anthropic.content:
# Anthropic launches Claude manufacturing plugin with 17 AI skills

Anthropic launched Claude for Manufacturing on Thursday, a plugin with 17 preconfigured skills for production-line teams including estimators, quality engineers, technicians and buyers.

The plugin connects Claude to Autodesk Fusion, Infor, Microsoft 365 and Oracle NetSuite, allowing users to work with design, procurement, production and business records through the AI system.

The skills cover sales, quality, operations, supply chain, design and setup. They include preparing quotes for new jobs, documenting failed inspections, diagnosing machine faults, sourcing equipment and compiling production data.

Lauren Collett, Anthropic’s head of enterprise industries go-to-market, said manufacturers told the company they have “more work than their experienced people have time to get through.” She said the tools aim to reduce repetitive back-office work and help companies make better use of existing staff.

For a failed inspection, Claude can document the incident, search past reports and email histories for similar defects, rank likely causes and draft a corrective-action report for a quality engineer to review, Collett said.

An estimator can submit a customer request and receive a list of missing information, cost comparisons with similar jobs and a draft quote. A technician can use Claude to assess likely causes of a machine failure using sensor data, repair notes, photos and operating manuals.

Claude can also help buyers prepare requests for quotation and compare supplier bids. Plant managers can use the plugin to generate reports comparing output with targets, downtime and the cost of both measures.

Autodesk Fusion users can ask Claude to create design variations, such as a lighter version of a metal bracket, and score them against requirements including strength, weight and cost.

A 2025 Manufacturing Leadership Council survey found that 79% of manufacturers said they entered data manually. Claude processes individual jobs or task sequences until a user must review the output.

Infor released its own plugin on the same day. The Infor connector within Claude for Manufacturing permits record lookups, while Infor Industry AI for Claude can let authorized users alter records, subject to their Infor permissions.

For example, a buyer facing a steel shipment delayed by two weeks can ask Claude which customer orders would be affected and how much steel other sites hold. With approval, Claude can issue a purchase order to another supplier and reschedule production.

“Manufacturers need answers grounded in how their business really runs, and then the ability to act on them,” Infor Chief Executive Kevin Samuelson said.

Infor Industry AI for Claude is available to select Infor Velocity Suite customers that hold their own Claude licenses. Enterprise and Team users can install the Anthropic plugin through a prompt, after which Claude checks connected systems and identifies unavailable skills.

Claude for Manufacturing does not operate equipment. Anthropic is separately developing a research preview called the Model Hardware Standard, intended to provide programmable machines with a common language for measurements, settings and safety limits.

Anthropic plans to release more manufacturing skills and has scheduled a technical webinar on the plugin for November 17 at 11 a.m. Eastern time.

Anthropic.content:
# Which Claude model should you build with? Fable, Opus, Sonnet, or Haiku

Ben SabicContent Engineer

Start with Claude Opus 5.5 for demanding application and agent work. Test Sonnet 5.5 when response speed matters, or Haiku 5.5 for bounded, high-volume tasks. Consider Fable 5.2 for difficult reasoning and extended investigations, especially when Opus at higher effort still misses your quality requirements.

The choice can differ within one application. Classifying an incoming support ticket and investigating contradictory account records require different amounts of reasoning. Define an acceptance test for each task before choosing its model.

## Copy link to headingHow do the current Claude models compare?

Anthropic recommends Opus for most workloads. Its model-selection guidance also supports starting with Haiku when efficiency is the main constraint, then moving up if evaluations reveal a capability gap. These are starting strategies you can test against your own data.

The prices below are standard USD rates per million tokens, before cache or batch discounts. They cover model input and output, so budget separately for the rest of your application. The suggested starting tasks follow Anthropic's model positioning.

Haiku's prompt length changes both its input and output rates. Account for that threshold when estimating the cost of document extraction or an agent that accumulates a long history. Estimates based on short tickets won't describe a workload that routinely exceeds 100,000 prompt tokens.

All four models accept text and images and return text. The native Claude API provides 1M-token context and a standard 128K-token output limit.

Those shared limits don't settle which model will interpret your evidence correctly. Provider routes can have different limits. For example, Haiku on Bedrock supports up to 64K output tokens.

## Copy link to headingFive use cases for Claude models

Choose a starting model based on what you need to learn. For an unfamiliar task, Opus can help establish whether your instructions and available evidence support a useful answer. For a high-volume job with known expected outputs, begin with Haiku and examine its failures before paying for more reasoning. Once a model meets your requirements, compare alternatives against the same cases.

Effort is another variable in that decision. The defaults differ across the lineup, so a default-settings comparison includes those differences. Keep a record of the model and effort setting for every evaluation. Tune effort on the current model before treating a failed case as evidence that you need another family.

### Copy link to heading1. Customer support and ticket triage

Start with Claude Haiku 5.5 for assigning tickets to a fixed set of queues or extracting an order number. These tasks give you specific errors to count, including whether ambiguous messages reach an exception queue.

Consider a customer who reports paying for an upgrade while their account still shows the free plan. Classifying the ticket as billing is a bounded task; resolving it requires payment and subscription records.

Test Sonnet for replies based on account records when response time matters.

If resolving the ticket requires reconciling contradictory records or deciding what evidence to request next, compare Opus. Reject even a fluent reply if it invents a payment status or promises an unsupported refund.

### Copy link to heading2. Internal knowledge assistants

For an assistant that answers employee questions from retrieved company information, try Claude Sonnet 5.5 first when people need an interactive response. Questions about reimbursable expenses test whether the assistant preserves policy conditions and cites the relevant source.

For example, a travel policy might allow meals within a daily limit while a project agreement requires separate approval. The assistant needs to explain which conditions apply and ask for the project details if they are missing.

Compare Opus if policy exceptions keep leading to incorrect answers.

Chat SDK is a TypeScript library for building bots across chat platforms from one codebase. It handles incoming messages and replies, giving this assistant a way to participate in a team's conversations. You can connect it to an AI SDK agent that uses your chosen Claude model.

Add this handler to an existing Chat SDK bot, wherebot is your configured Chat instance. On Vercel, AI Gateway authenticates through OIDC.

lib/bot.ts
import { streamText } from 'ai';
bot.onNewMention(async (thread, message) => {  const result = streamText({    model: 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5',    instructions:      'Answer using the supplied policy text. Ask for missing details.',    prompt: message.text,    abortSignal: thread.signal,  });  await thread.post(result.textStream);});
The handler streams Sonnet's response to each mention, using policy text included in that message. To compare Opus on questions involving conflicting policies, changemodel to anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 and submit the same question and excerpts. Check whether the answer preserves the relevant approval conditions.

### Copy link to heading3. Document extraction and analysis

Claude Haiku 5.5 is a useful first candidate for extracting known fields from consistent documents, such as invoice numbers and due dates. Include missing fields in the evaluation so that guessing does not count as successful extraction.

Contract review introduces a different problem. An amendment may change the renewal date but leave cancellation requirements intact, so extracting dates from each document does not establish the current obligations.

Start with Opus for this interpretation work, where the answer depends on relationships across documents. Once that interpretation is reliable, compare Sonnet on the same evidence. Check that every conclusion is supported by the cited passage; valid structured output alone cannot establish that the model applied an exception correctly.

### Copy link to heading4. Coding and debugging

Test Claude Sonnet 5.5 on bounded changes with a clear expected result, such as updating a component against an existing specification. Supply the expected interaction and existing tests so that the agent has a concrete target.

Start an ambiguous refactor or repository-wide investigation with Opus when the agent needs to trace dependencies across files. Changes to shared authentication code, for example, may affect several sign-in paths.

Evaluate the actual diff and relevant tests, including password reset and session renewal if they use the edited code. Reserve a Fable comparison for difficult cases that remain unresolved after that investigation, using the failed attempts and available evidence to define what a better result must accomplish.

### Copy link to heading5. Research and complex investigations

Use Claude Opus 5.5 to establish a baseline for research that requires comparing sources and examining competing explanations. For example, a technical research brief might compare two database designs against a supplied workload. It should distinguish measured behavior from assumptions and explain which unanswered questions could change the recommendation.

Compare Sonnet on narrower briefs with examples of acceptable results.

Fable becomes a candidate when extended reasoning remains the obstacle, particularly if higher-effort Opus repeatedly misses a relationship in evidence it already has. Additional reasoning cannot compensate for a missing source, so inspect those failures before expanding the comparison.

## Copy link to headingWhen is Fable worth evaluating?

Evaluate Fable when a task needs sustained reasoning or when Opus still fails on important cases after you have tested higher effort. Fable's intended workloads include demanding analysis and agents that work through extended tasks. That makes it a candidate for the unresolved portion of an investigation, without requiring you to move routine classification onto the same model.

Consider an incident review in which several logs support different explanations. Ask Fable to identify the contradiction, retain plausible hypotheses, and propose an observation that would distinguish them.

Compare its answer with Opus on the same evidence. Judge whether the proposed next step can resolve the uncertainty, and reject unsupported conclusions.

Before spending on that comparison, inspect the failed Opus output. If the model never received the relevant log or misunderstood an undefined business term, fix the input. When the evidence is present and the model repeatedly draws an unsupported connection, you have a more informative case for testing Fable.

Fable also has a deployment constraint that can settle the decision before evaluation. It requires 30-day retention of prompts and completions. If your team requires zero data retention, AI Gateway rejects requests to Fable. Check the route against your data requirements before using Fable.

## Copy link to headingHow do you compare Claude models with AI SDK?

Keep the task definition and input fixed when comparing candidates. AI SDK accepts Gateway model ID strings ingenerateText, so you can change the model without rewriting the classification logic. These IDs use a dot in the version, such as 5.5; native Claude API IDs use hyphens.

This server-side example uses AI SDK 7 andzod, with AI Gateway authentication handled by Vercel OIDC. It uses structured output to compare Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus on one fictional ticket. This first comparison leaves Fable out because the task only asks for classification and missing evidence.

# #Gate直通IPO第三期Anthropic 根据公开招股说明书信息、媒体报道和最新产品进展，以下从用户体验、产品竞争力、商业模式、商业前景和风险五个维度分析 Anthropic 及其旗舰产品 Claude。

1. 用户体验：能力与局限之间的落差

Claude 的用户体验呈现出明显的“两极化”特征：

· 能力上限高：于 2026 年 11 月 9 日发布的 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Mythos 5.2 被定位为目前能力最强的模型。它们在复杂软件工程、科学推理、图表理解和机器人控制方面表现出色。

例如，Fable 5.2 在 FrontierCode 2.0 编码基准测试中得分为 49.1%，优于同期竞争对手；在模拟双臂机器人测试中的成功率达到 64.9%。新模型还展现出协调 1,000 多个子智能体，并持续编写操作系统原型长达 8 天的能力。

· 对个人用户的限制：尽管模型能力强大，但个人用户，尤其是免费用户和 Pro 用户，常常面临用量上限、速率限制和严格的风险控制。一些用户反映，在中国大陆等地区，风险控制相对严格，账号封禁也较为频繁。

· 体验差距的根本原因：这种差异源于算力分配策略。由于算力有限，公司优先服务高价值企业客户。招股说明书承认，公司“一直处于算力受限的环境中”，未来可能调整用量限制，进而影响个人用户体验的稳定性。

2. 产品竞争力：智能体与企业工作流。

Anthropic 的核心竞争优势已从简单的“聊天机器人”转向“自主智能体”和“嵌入企业工作流”：

· Claude Code 推动使用量增长：Claude Code 被视为定义自主 AI 工作的关键产品。招股说明书数据显示，2026 年第三季度，Claude Code 企业用户中使用量排名前 5% 的用户，月均支出约为未使用该功能用户的 20 倍。

这表明，能够自主编写代码、运行测试和修复漏洞的智能体，是消耗算力并创造收入的核心用例。

· 模型阵容与定价：当前模型阵容包括 Mythos（含 Fable）、Opus、Sonnet 和 Haiku。2026 年 11 月推出的新模型标准定价为每百万个输入 token 8 美元、每百万个输出 token 40 美元，比上一代低 20%，同时输出速度快 30%；此外还提供超高速模式这一性能更高的选项。

· 安全与对齐：公司强调“宪法式 AI”和安全研究。面向普通用户的 Fable 版本配备全面的安全防护，而限制较少的 Mythos 版本仅向经过审核的机构开放。这种差异化策略既满足公众对安全的需求，也为专业领域的探索保留了空间。

3. 商业模式：由 B2B 和云渠道主导Anthropic 的业务结构高度依赖企业客户和云服务商渠道，个人用户的贡献相对较小：

· 收入构成：2026 年上半年，按使用量计费的收入约为 130.64 亿美元，占总收入约 80%；订阅收入约为 32.22 亿美元，占比约 20%。订阅收入没有进一步区分个人用户（Pro/Max）和企业套餐（Team/Enterprise），但个人用户的贡献肯定低于 20%。

· 对云渠道的依赖：通过 Amazon、Google 和 Microsoft 等云服务商市场实现的销售占比持续上升。2026 年上半年，云服务商渠道贡献了约 48% 的收入，接近一半。

· 客户结构：截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，过去 12 个月收入超过 10 万美元的客户数量，从一年前的 950 多家激增至 11,900 多家。前五大客户合计贡献约 25% 的收入，对任何单一客户的依赖仍处于可控范围。

· 客户黏性：截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，净收入留存率（NRR）高达约 900%。但需注意，个人订阅用户不计入这一指标，该指标主要反映企业客户的业务扩张。

4. 商业前景：快速增长，但成本仍需消化根据财务和运营数据，Anthropic 正处于高速增长阶段，但盈利质量和实现资本化的路径仍有待观察：

· 收入增长：2026 年上半年收入为 162.86 亿美元，是 2025 全年收入（45.85 亿美元）的 3.55 倍。2026 年第二季度收入达到 115.55 亿美元，同比增长 1,368%。

· 盈利转折点：公司在 2026 年第二季度实现 9.74 亿美元的营业利润，营业利润率约为 8.4%，标志着公司首次在营业层面实现季度盈利。这主要是因为收入增长（1,368%）远超计算和基础设施费用的增幅（约 300%），且计算费用占收入的比例从 177% 降至 48%。

· 账面亏损：尽管营业层面已扭亏为盈，2026 年上半年净亏损仍高达 807.48 亿美元。其中大部分，即 723.88 亿美元，来自可转换债券、衍生负债和 SAFEs 的公允价值变动。这些属于非现金会计费用，并不直接表明经营现金流恶化。

· 估值与 IPO：公司计划于 2026 年 11 月中旬左右在 Nasdaq 上市，股票代码为 ANT。媒体报道称，估值讨论区间为 1.5 万亿美元至 2 万亿美元，而该公司在 5 月的 H 轮融资后估值为 9,650 亿美元。

· 人均效率：截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，公司约有 5,300 名员工，过去 12 个月人均收入超过 660 万美元，体现出极高的人才密度和运营效率。

5. 风险与挑战

尽管前景可期，招股说明书和市场分析中反复提及以下风险因素：

· 算力供应与分配：公司承认客户需求超过可用算力。算力长期供不应求，在高价值企业用户和个人用户之间平衡资源分配，可能带来声誉风险。

· 成本压力：尽管第二季度计算效率有所提升，但部分已签约的算力尚未交付，相关成本将在一段时间内确认。后续成本上升可能会压缩利润率。

· 竞争格局：OpenAI 等竞争对手正在加剧企业市场竞争，企业也可能采用价格更低的开放权重模型。Anthropic 2026 年第三季度的收入环比增长率（45%）已低于第二季度的增速（环比增长 144%），这表明边际增长可能已开始放缓。

· 个人用户转化：免费用户消耗的算力计入“销售和营销”费用。公司希望将他们转化为付费客户，但招股说明书也承认，转化可能无法成功，而且免费层可能会蚕食付费订阅。

· 会计与估值波动：报告的巨额净亏损主要源于金融工具的公允价值变动。投资者应区分营业盈利能力与会计亏损。此外，IPO 估值受市场情绪影响，可能会有所调整。

总结

Anthropic 目前展现出极强的企业商业化能力。Claude Code 等产品深度嵌入企业工作流，推动收入呈指数级增长，并实现营业层面扭亏为盈。其核心优势在于模型能力、安全对齐和企业渠道的垂直整合。然而，其商业前景仍受算力供应瓶颈、高昂的基础设施成本和激烈的市场竞争制约。

对于个人用户而言，尽管这些模型的能力位居顶尖水平，但长期来看，他们在产品阵容中的优先级可能仍较低。如果公司能继续保持收入增长快于成本增长，其长期价值将得到进一步验证；反之，如果算力成本失控或企业客户增长放缓，其高估值将面临考验。

This creates a tailored assistant rather than a new AI model. ... How to create and configure a custom GPT in ChatGPT
OpenAI.content:
# How to build a custom GPT in ChatGPT before the plugin transition

You can make a custom GPT in ChatGPT by combining instructions, reference files, and tools for a specific task. This creates a tailored assistant rather than a new AI model. New GPT creation is now restricted as custom GPTs transition to plugins, so check your account’s availability before starting.

Before you start: Use ChatGPT in a web browser and sign in to a workspace with permission to create GPTs, or an account that permits editing an existing GPT. Mobile apps support using GPTs, but not creating them. Personal Free, Go, Plus, and Pro accounts cannot create or publish new GPTs. In Business, Enterprise, and Edu workspaces, availability depends on workspace settings, permissions, and transition notices.

New GPT creation ended for affected Enterprise workspaces on October 26, 2026, except for FedRAMP workspaces. Standard retirement is scheduled for December 11, 2026. FedRAMP workspaces and those with a qualifying, approved deferral have a retirement date of February 11, 2027. Existing unmigrated GPTs remain usable and editable until the applicable date, subject to permissions; migrated GPTs become read-only.

## How to create and configure a custom GPT in ChatGPT

Follow the route available to your account, then configure and test your assistant before saving it.

### Start a new GPT in an eligible workspace

- Open Explore GPTs in the ChatGPT sidebar, or visit the GPTs page.
- Select Create to open the GPT builder. If creation is unavailable, check your workspace notice and permissions rather than assuming a paid subscription enables it.
- Choose how you want to build your assistant:
- If you prefer guided setup, use the conversational builder and describe its audience, task, and expected output. For example, ask for an assistant that turns meeting notes into decisions, action items, and unanswered questions.
- If you already know what you need, use the configuration view to edit the fields directly.

- Review the resulting configuration using the setup steps below. Treat any automatically drafted instructions as a starting point, not a finished specification.

### Open an existing GPT for editing

- Open Explore GPTs, select My GPTs, and choose the assistant you want to change.
- Select Edit GPT to open its configuration.
- If you are already chatting with the GPT, open its menu and select Edit GPT instead.
- If the GPT has already migrated, its original version is read-only. Follow your account’s migration notice to continue working with the migrated workflow.
- If new creation has been disabled but your GPT remains unmigrated, you can still edit it when your plan and permissions allow.

- Use the configuration steps below to adjust its behavior, files, and tools.

### Configure the assistant’s behavior and tools

- Enter a clear, specific title in Name. A name such as “Meeting action planner” explains the purpose more clearly than a generic name such as “Productivity helper.”
- Write a short Description explaining who the GPT serves and which tasks it handles. The name and description help people understand the assistant in previews, shared links, and listings where available.
- Add realistic prompts under Conversation starters. For a meeting assistant, examples could include “Turn these notes into assigned action items” and “Identify decisions that still need an owner.”
- Use Instructions to define the task, tone, response structure, and decision rules that should apply in every conversation.
- If the workflow has several stages, separate them with headings or lists and use direct conditions such as “When notes do not identify an owner, mark the owner as unassigned.”
- If consistent classification matters, include short examples of acceptable and unacceptable outputs.
- If responses are too vague, replace broad requests with concrete directions. For example, specify that each action item should include a task, owner, and deadline when provided.

- Upload reference documents under Knowledge, keeping behavioral rules in Instructions. You can attach up to 20 files, with a maximum size of 512 MB per file.
- For documents and handbooks, prefer clear, text-forward files over complex layouts.
- If a file type is unavailable, check model compatibility and whether Code Interpreter & Data Analysis needs to be enabled. Supported formats vary by model and configuration.

- Choose a Recommended model if a particular available model suits the task. This suggests a starting model rather than locking users to it.
- If that model is unavailable to a user, a similar model may be selected automatically.
- If you leave the recommendation unset, users can choose an available model. Users may also switch models when their account offers alternatives.

- Enable only the Capabilities the assistant needs. Availability varies by account, workspace, and region.
- For current online information, enable Web search.
- For creating pictures from prompts, enable Image generation.
- For drafting and refining longer content, enable Canvas.
- For calculations, spreadsheet analysis, and charts, enable Code Interpreter & Data Analysis.

- Choose an external integration only when the workflow requires one:
- Use Apps for connected services and tools available to the user. Users may need to connect an app or confirm its use.
- Use Actions for defined external APIs that retrieve data or perform operations in another system.
- Select either apps or actions, since a GPT cannot use both simultaneously.

### Test, save, and manage your GPT

- Run representative prompts in Preview. Check whether the GPT follows the requested format, handles missing information, and uses uploaded files accurately.
- Test both straightforward requests and ambiguous ones. If the results are inconsistent, refine the instructions and add examples before enabling more tools.
- Save the tested configuration using the option that matches your situation:
- For a new GPT in an eligible managed workspace, select Create.
- For an existing GPT, select Update to apply the latest changes.

- Remember that editing automatically saves a draft, but a draft is not the same as an applied update. Before migration, apply any changes you want to keep: migration transfers the latest published version, not drafts or unpublished edits. Public sharing is not required.
- Select Share to review the sharing options available to your account or workspace. New GPT publishing remains unavailable on personal accounts.
- Open the ••• menu to access management options after the GPT has been created.
- To recover an earlier configuration, open Version history and review or restore a previous version. If that version uses actions, you may need to reconfigure authentication afterward.
- To distribute an existing GPT, copy its link if your permissions allow it.
- To duplicate a GPT, confirm that you have the required permissions and that your workspace remains eligible to create new GPTs.
- Before selecting Delete, confirm that you no longer need the GPT and retain any configuration material you want to keep.

Pro tip: Keep a small set of test prompts with expected results. Run them after changing instructions, replacing files, or switching models so you can spot regressions before others use the GPT.

A useful custom GPT starts with a narrow job and clear expectations. Once it handles that job reliably, expand its responsibilities only when testing shows that the added complexity helps.

With retirement approaching, keep a separate copy of your instructions and original reference files. Check your account’s transition notice for migration access and deadlines. Plugins are intended to carry reusable instructions, reference files, and connected apps into the next version of these workflows.

OpenAI.content:
原文地址 www.techbeat.net

TechBeat 是荟聚全球华人 AI 精英的成长社区，每周上新来自顶尖大厂、明星创业公司、国际顶级高校相关专业在读博士的最新研究工作。我们希望为 AI 人才打造更专业的服务和体验，加速并陪伴其成长。

最近 ChatGPT 可以说是火遍了全世界，作为由知名人工智能研究机构 OpenAI 于 2022 年 11 月 30 日发布的一个大型语言预训练模型，他的核心在于能够理解人类的自然语言，并使用贴近人类语言风格的方式来进行回复。模型开放使用以来，在人工智能领域引起了巨大的轰动，也成功火出了技术圈。从数据上看，ChatGPT 用户数在 5 天内就达到了 100 万，2 个月就达到了 1 亿；另外，在很多非人工智能领域，已经有机构在尝试用 ChatGPT 去做一些智能生成的事。例如财通证券发布了一篇由 ChatGPT 生成的行业研报，从研报的可读性和专业性上来看，虽然在细节上有很多需要推敲的地方，但是整体框架内容已经比较成熟。对于其他内容生产者来说，应用 ChatGPT 也能够提升个人的生产效率。

ChatGPT 的强大能力是显而易见的，但对于人工智能领域不太熟悉的人，对这种黑盒的技术仍然会担忧或者不信任。恐惧通常来自于不了解，因此本文将为大家全面剖析 ChatGPT 的技术原理，尽量以简单通俗的文字为大家解惑。

通过本文，你可以有以下收获：

1、知道 ChatGPT 是什么

2、ChatGPT 有哪些核心要素

3、ChatGPT 能做哪些事

4、ChatGPT 不能做哪些事

## ChatGPT 是什么？

上文说到 ChatGPT 实际上是一个大型语言预训练模型（即 Large Language Model，后面统一简称 LLM）。什么叫 LLM？LLM 指的是利用大量文本数据来训练的语言模型，这种模型可以产生出强大的语言关联能力，能够从上下文中抽取出更多的信息。其实语言模型的研究从很早就开始了，随着算力的发展和数据规模的增长，语言模型的能力随着模型参数量的增加而提升。下图分别展示了 LLM 在参数量和数据量上的进化情况，其中数据量图例展示的是模型在预训练过程中会见到的 token 数量，对于中文来说一个 token 就相当于一个中文字符。

为什么语言模型的参数量和数据量会朝着越来越大的方向发展呢？在早些时间的一些研究已经证明，随着参数量和训练数据量的增大，语言模型的能力会随着参数量的指数增长而线性增长，这种现象被称为 Scaling Law（下图左例）。但是在 2022 年之后，随着进来对大模型的深入研究，人们发现当模型的参数量大于一定程度的时候，模型能力会突然暴涨，模型会突然拥有一些突变能力（Emergent Ability，下图右例），如推理能力、零样本学习能力等（后面均会介绍）。

ChatGPT 真正强大的地方在于他除了能够充分理解我们人类的问题需求外，还能够用流畅的自然语言进行应答，这是以前的语言模型不能实现的。下面，本文将 ChatGPT 一分为二，分别从 GPT 和 Chat 两个维度来介绍 ChatGPT 的机理。值得说明的是：当前 OpenAI 并未放出 ChatGPT 相关的训练细节和论文，也没有开源代码，只能从其技术 BLOG 上获取其大致的训练框架和步骤，因此本文介绍的内容将根据后续实际发布的官方细节而更新。

## GPT

GPT 全称 Generative Pre-training Transformer，由 Google 在 2018 年提出的一种预训练语言模型。他的核心是一个 Transformer 结构，主要基于注意力机制来建模序列中不同位置之间的关联关系，最后可用于处理序列生成的任务。通过使用大量的文本数据，GPT 可以生成各种各样的文本，包括对话、新闻报道、小说等等。上面提到了很多次语言模型，这里简单给出语言模型主要的涵义：

给定已知的 token 序列 N_t（对中文来说是字符，对英文来说可能是单词或者词根），通过语言模型来预测 t+1 位置上的 token 是什么。实际上模型输出的是所有 token 在 t+1 位置上的概率向量，然后根据概率最大的准则选择 token。大家在使用 ChatGPT 的时候，一定有发现机器人在生成回复的时候是一个字一个字的顺序，背后的机制就是来自于这边。

对语言模型来说，可能大家之前更熟悉的是 BERT，BERT 是 Google 在 2018 年发布的一种双向语言模型，发布后，其在不同语言理解类任务（如文本分类，信息抽取，文本相似度建模）中都达到了当期时间节点的最好效果。BERT 与上述语言模型的机理有所不同，其训练任务相当于让模型去做完形填空任务（官方称为 Masked Language Model 任务，下文简称 MLM)，并不是遵循文本一个接一个预测的顺序，其模型机制与人类沟通表达的习惯不太符合。图中左半部分是 BERT 的示意图，右半部是 GPT 的示意图，Trm 为一个 Transformer 模型组件，E 为输入的 token 序列，T 为模型生成的 token 序列。

其中，实线部分为该位置的 Trm 能够看到哪些其他位置 token 的上下文知识。可以看到，对于 BERT 来说，每个位置上的 Trm 都能看到任意位置的上下文知识，因此其在具体的自然语言理解任务上会有不错的效果。而 GPT 则是遵循传统语言模型的模式，例如 index=1 位置的 Trm 是无法看到 index>1 的知识的，因此它在自然语言理解任务上的效果不如 BERT，但是在生成任务上会更符合人类的直觉。业界把 BERT 中的 MLM 模式称为自编码形式 (auto-encoding)，把 GPT 的模式称为自回归形式（auto-regressive）。

大家从 BERT 和 GPT 的对比中可以看到，BERT 在语言理解上似乎更具优势，那为何现在 ChatGPT 的模型基座是 GPT 呢？这就涉及到最近两年逐渐清晰的 NLP 任务大一统趋势了。

## NLP 任务大一统

基于 MLM 训练范式得到的 BERT 模型虽然在很多语言理解类任务上有不错的效果下游任务，之后整个业界在处理 NLP 任务的时候通常会遵循预训练模型→下游任务 finetune 的流程：

这种方式与传统的 training from scratch 相比，对下游任务数据的需求量更少，得到的效果也更优。不过，上述方式还是存在一些问题：

处理一个新的任务就需要标注新的语料，对语料的需求比较大，之前已经做过的任务语料无法高效利用。即使是信息抽取下面的不同任务（如实体识别和关系抽取两个任务）也无法通用化。

处理一个新的任务需要针对任务特性设计整体模型方案，虽然 BERT 模型的底座已经确定，但还是需要一定的设计工作量。例如文本分类的任务和信息抽取的任务的模型方案就完全不同。

对于要走向通用人工智能方向的人类来说，这种范式很难达到通用，对每个不同任务都用单独的模型方案和数据来训练显然也是低效的。因此，为了让一个模型能够尽量涵盖更多的任务，业界尝试了几种不同的路径来实现这个目标。

对 BERT 中的 MLM 进行改造，如引入一些特殊的 Mask 机制，使其能够同时支持多种不同任务，典型的模型如 UniLM https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.03197

引入额外的 Decoder，将 BERT 优化改造成能做生成式的模型，典型的工作有 BART（https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.13461），T5（https://arxiv.org/pdf/1910.10683.pdf），百度的 UIE（将任务设计生成 text-to-structure 的形式实现信息抽取的大一统 ）。我对 T5 比较熟悉，之前也写过相关的分析，这个工作算是比较早地尝试将不同任务通过文本生成的方式进行大一统。如图所示，T5 训练时直接输入了不同下游 NLP 任务的标注数据，通过在原始文本的前端添加任务的提示文本，来让模型学习不同任务的特性。如翻译任务可以是”translate English to German”, 分类任务可以是跟具体分类目标有关如”cola sentence”, 也可以是一种摘要任务”summarize”。

怎么样，是不是觉得跟 ChatGPT 的模式有相似的地方？

这种方式可以同时利用多种 NLP 任务相关的公开数据集，一下子就把预训练任务从语言模型扩展到了更多任务类型中，增强了模型的通用性以及对下游任务的理解能力。

- 除了上面两种方式外，还有其他改造 BERT 的方法就不穷举了，如苏神通过 Gibbs 采样来实现 BERT 模型的文本生成等。（https://kexue.fm/archives/8119）

虽然有很多大一统的路径，但是 OpenAI 一直坚持着 GPT 的方向不断演化着，2019 年他们发布了 GPT2，这个模型相对于 GPT 来说，主要是扩大了参数量，扩大了训练语料，在构建语料的时候隐式地包含了 multitask 或者 multidomain 的特质，最后在二阶段验证模型的时候并不是直接做有监督的 finetune，而是继续用下游数据做无监督的训练，最后的效果居然还不错，证明了只要模型够大，就能学到足够的知识用于处理一些下游任务。从它的论文名字就可以看出其核心思想：Language models are unsupervised multitask learners 。不过彼时，BERT 及其各种变种在领域中的应用还是更广的，真正让 GPT 系列模型惊艳众人的工作还是要数 2020 年发布的 GPT-3 模型。Language Models are Few-Shot Learners

## GPT-3

首先，说几个跟 GPT-3 相关的数字：

OpenAI 训练初版的 GPT-3，比 GPT-2 整整用了 15 倍的语料，同时模型参数量扩展了 100 多倍。这么多资源的投入，使得 GPT-3 成为了一个 “庞然巨物”，其产生的效果也是惊人的。除了在很多 NLP 的任务上有着很不错的指标外，其本身也产生了一种前所未有的能力——In-context learning。

## 何为 In-context learning？

简单来说，就是模型在不更新自身参数的情况下，通过在模型输入中带入新任务的描述与少量的样本，就能让模型” 学习” 到新任务的特征，并且对新任务中的样本产生不错的预测效果。这种能力可以当做是一种小样本学习能力。可以参考下图的例子来理解：其中，task description 和 examples 用来帮助模型学习新任务，最后的 Prompt 用来测试模型是否学会了。

与传统的小样本学习范式还是有所不同，之前主流的小样本学习范式以 Meta-learning 为主，通过将训练数据拆成不同的小任务进行元学习。在学习的过程中，模型的参数是一直在变化的，这是最大的一个不同点。

那不更新参数的小样本学习有什么好处呢？

对于大模型来说，这可是极佳的特性。因为大模型的微调成本通常都极为庞大，很少有公司能够具备微调训练的资源。因此，如果能够通过 In-context learning 的特性，让大模型快速学习下游任务，在相对较小的成本下（对大模型进行前向计算）快速完成算法需求，可以大大提升技术部门的生产力。

In-context learning 的效果固然惊艳，但是对于一些包含复杂上下文或者需要多步推理的任务仍然有其局限性，这也是业界一直以来致力于让人工智能拥有的能力——推理能力。那么大模型具有推理能力吗？对于 GPT-3 来说，答案是可以有，但有一定的限制。我们先来看看它有的部分。

还记得文章开头提到的大模型的涌现能力吧，In-context 正是属于当模型参数量达到一定程度后，突然出现的能力之一。那么除此以外，还有什么能力是涌现的呢？答案就是——Chain-of-thought，即思维链能力。

## 怎么理解 In-context learning？

GPT-3 拥有的 In-context learning 能力可以说有很大程度来自于其庞大的参数量和训练数据，但是具体能力来源仍然难以溯源。不过，最近已经有一些论文专门针对其进行了研究，如清华大学、北京大学和微软的研究员共同发表了一篇论文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.10559，探索了 GPT 作为一个语言模型，可以视作是一个元优化器，并可将 In-context learning 理解为一种隐性的微调。

## 何为 Chain-of-thought（COT）？

实际上是对输入的 Prompt 采用 Chain-of-thought 的思想进行改写。传统的 Prompt 中，对于一个复杂或者需要多步计算推导的问题样例，会直接给出答案作为 In-context learning 的学习范例与新任务的测试样例输入到大模型中。这样做往往不能得到正确的结果，如图所示：（https://arxiv.org/pdf/2205.11916.pdf）

然而，当我们将上述问题范例中的答案再细化一些，对推到出答案的每一个步骤都写出来，再将测试样例一起输入到模型中，此时模型居然能够正确回答了，而且也能够参照范例中的样例进行一定的推理，如图所示：

上述的模型输入中，还带有可参考的问题范例，还属于小样本的范畴。诡异的是，有人使用了一种匪夷所思的方法，让其具备了零样本的推理能力：在问题样例的答案中增加一句 Let’s think step by step. 然后模型居然能够回答出之前不能回答的问题。

当然，上图中模型并未直接给出一个简洁的答案，而是给出了推导答案的步骤，论文中则是将上述 output 与输入模型的 Prompt 拼在一块，再次输入模型，最终得到了简洁的答案输出：

既然大模型具备了 COT 的特性，那么就能说明它具备了推理能力了吗？答案是不确定的。因为在更多的复杂逻辑推理类任务或者计算任务上，大模型还是无法回答。简单来说就是他可以做一些简单的小学应用题，但是稍微复杂一点的问题它就是在瞎猜了。具体的例子可以参考这篇论文中的分析：Limitations of Language Models in Arithmetic and Symbolic Induction

## Chain-of-Thought 能力来自于哪儿？

上一小节在介绍 COT 特性的时候，都是统一用 GPT-3 来代表。其实，** 原始的 GPT-3 版本中并没有显著地发现其具备 COT 特性。对于大众来说，像是 chatGPT 突然就有了这样的能力。其实，在 chatGPT 出来之前，openAI 对 GPT-3 做了很多迭代优化工作。而 GPT-3 的 COT 特性就是在这些迭代优化中逐渐展现。但不可否认的是，目前仍然没有确定性的结论说明 COT 特性来自于具体哪些迭代优化。有些观点说是通过引入强化学习，有些观点则是说通过引入了指令微调的训练方式，也有些观点说是通过引入庞大的代码预训练语料，使得模型从代码逻辑中学习到了相应知识。推测的方式则是根据不同时间节点上的模型版本能力差进行排除法，虽然目前我们受限于技术能力只能从这些蛛丝马迹中去发现一些端倪，但仍然具有一定的借鉴意义。具体的推理过程本文不会重复，感兴趣的可以参考如下博客：https://franxyao.github.io/blog.html。

## Instruction-Tuning 与 RLFH 技术

虽然对于大模型突变能力的来源还不能轻易下结论，但是在其迭代优化过程中，引入的一些技术确实提升了（更准确得说是激活）大模型的能力。根据 OpenAI 的技术博客所述，ChatGPT 的训练方式主要参考了 InstructGPT（https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.02155），而 InstructGPT 主要涉及了两个核心的技术实现：指令微调（Instruction-Tuning）以及基于人工反馈的强化学习（Reinforcement learning from Human Feedback)，下面将对其进行介绍。

### Instruction-Tuning

Instruction-Tuning（下称指令微调）技术，最早来自于谷歌 Deepmind 的 Quoc V.Le 团队在 2021 年发表的论文《Finetuned Language Models Are Zero-Shot Learners》(https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.01652)。在说指令微调前，必须得先介绍下 21 年初开始业界开始关注的 Prompt-learning 范式。2021 年 4 月，我在 InfoQ 的架构师大会上做了一次技术演讲，分享了我们在 Prompt 上的一些研究实践，如下图所示：

Prompt-learning 最早来自于论文《Exploiting Cloze Questions for Few Shot Text Classification and Natural Language Inference》https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.07676，当时把里面的范式简称为 PET（Pattern-exploiting Training）。其核心思想为将不同类型的自然语言理解任务与 BERT 预训练中的掩码语言模型任务进行转化靠拢。例如对于图中的实体情感分类任务，本身其分类标签是一个三维的空间。我通过设置一个 prompt 提示文本模板：由此可见，英伟达的舆情是 {}，同时设计一个锚点，将原始分类目标的空间映射到语言模型中的子空间 {正 / 负 / 中}，通过预测锚点位置的 token 间接得到情感标签。这种方式的优点在于能够将下游任务与语言模型在预训练任务中的训练范式达成一致，减少下游任务在模型学习迁移过程中的知识损失，在小样本的场景下比普通的 Finetune 模式会有更好的效果。

Prompt-learning 实际上是一种语言模型能够股泛化不同任务的方式，从广义层面上来看，可以有多种实现方式，例如上面的 PET，本文之前提到的 T5 模型，以及初版的 GPT-3 等。指令微调实际上也可以算作是广义 Prompt-learning 中的一种实现方式（个人愚见）。它的核心思想是尽可能收集不同类型的自然语言处理任务（包括理解和生成），并使用自然语言设计对应的任务指令，让模型试图理解不同任务的指令与特性，最终通过语言模型生成的方式完成不同任务的训练，指令微调实例如下图所示：

那么指令微调与 BERT、T5、GPT-3 等 Prompt 方式有什么区别呢？

BERT 类的 Prompt 设计与掩码语言模型任务相关，Prompt 模板和锚点要与任务对应，需要一定量的标注样本进行小样本训练。

T5 的 Prompt 更像是在预训练时对不同语言任务的数据打上了不同的标记，让模型对语言任务有了初步的理解，但是不够深入，无法应用在零样本的场景。

GPT-3 的 Prompt 中，会基于在模型训练过程中见过的数据，更像是让模型将 Prompt 中的文本进行续写。这种方式可以帮助模型更好地理解用户输入的内容，并产生更准确和自然的输出。但其在零样本场景下效果仍然不佳。

指令微调技术使用 Prompt 来为模型提供一系列指令或者命令，这些指令或命令会告诉模型应该如何进行特定任务的处理。与 GPT-3 中的 Prompt 不同，指令微调中的 Prompt 是针对特定任务和特定的模型进行设计的，相当于是指导模型如何完成任务。指令微调技术提升了模型的零样本学习能力。模型对于未见过的任务也能够理解并尝试处理。在 GPT-3 后续的迭代版本中，加入了指令微调后，即使在 Prompt 中不引入带标注的样本，模型也能够比较好的理解需求并得到不错的效果。

目前公开开源的模型 FLAN T5 就是在 T5 模型基础上进行了指令微调的训练，相较于那些动辄几百亿、几千亿参数的大模型来说，这个模型的参数量已经足够亲民，可以作为个人研究或者业务实现的 strong baseline

在 ChatGPT 公开后，各种五花八门的 Prompt 层出不穷。有让其作为一个 linux 终端的，有让其作为一个二次元猫娘的，也有让他写武侠小说的。感觉上 ChatGPT 可以做任何事情，只要你的脑洞足够大。这种通才特质有很大一部分要归功于指令微调。只要我们设计的 Prompt 指令足够清晰完整，模型总能够理解我们要干什么，并尽量按照我们的需求去完成任务。我认为这是其有别于过往大模型的重要特性之一。

一些开放性的生成性语言任务并不存在固定正确的答案。因此

## ChatGPT 扩展能力：GPTs / Actions / 工具

⚠️ ChatGPT Plugins（插件）已废弃。 OpenAI 于 2024 年 3 月 19 日停止新建插件会话，并在 2024 年 4 月 9 日彻底下线整个插件体系。原插件的能力现已由 GPTs（自定义 GPT，可附带指令、知识文件与能力）、Actions（让自定义 GPT 通过 OpenAPI Schema 调用外部 API，等价并超越原插件）以及 GPT Store 的分发机制取代。如需更通用、跨应用的工具与数据连接方式，推荐使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol）。因此本章不再涉及"插件 waitlist 申请"。

OpenAI.title: Murray presses OpenAI on ChatGPT safeguards after Seattle woman’s death
OpenAI.description: OpenAI added that “while ChatGPT is not a substitute for medical care, we believe AI can play a role in helping people make sense of health information.” ... The lawsuit claims the design features of GPT-4o, the model Wan was using ... ” and that the company “abandoned safety to win the AI race.”
OpenAI.content:
# Murray presses OpenAI on ChatGPT safeguards after Seattle woman’s death

U.S. Sen. Patty Murray pressed OpenAI Thursday for answers on how their chatbot products handle medical questions after the death of a Seattle woman who, according to a lawsuit filed by her parents, reduced her seizure medication based on ChatGPT’s advice.

In a letter to OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, the Washington state Democrat wrote regarding the death of Bowen Wan, 31. Murray called the fact that chatbots are helping guide potentially life-or-death decisions “unacceptable.” She demanded that the company “take accountability and provide assurance this can never happen again.”

“A chatbot is not a doctor and no AI tool should steer people away from their doctors — or towards harm,” Murray wrote.

Murray gave OpenAI until Dec. 1 to respond. Among her questions: What safeguards the company has added since Wan’s death? Whether OpenAI’s systems flag when a user reports urgent symptoms? And who reviews those responses?

“This is an incredibly heartbreaking situation,” an OpenAI spokesperson said of Wan’s death, in an emailed statement Thursday.

The company is “working closely with clinicians and other experts,” the spokesperson said, to adjust how ChatGPT reacts in sensitive situations.

OpenAI added that “while ChatGPT is not a substitute for medical care, we believe AI can play a role in helping people make sense of health information.”

Wan’s parents sued OpenAI in October. The lawsuit claims the design features of GPT-4o, the model Wan was using, were “uniquely dangerous,” and that the company “abandoned safety to win the AI race.”

The chatbot helped design a plan for Wan to taper off her epilepsy medication and encouraged her to keep going and to not tell her physician, even as she repeatedly expressed reservations, the lawsuit contends.

GPT-4o stirred past controversy for being overly agreeable with users. Murray asked the company why the AI model wasn’t suspended sooner. OpenAI removed it from its consumer app Feb. 13, the day after the medical examiner believes Wan died, according to The New York Times.

Murray also asked whether the chatbot’s safeguards hold up in non-English languages. Wan switched between English and Mandarin in the 1,500 messages she sent per week, on average, in 2025, according to The New York Times.

The West Health-Gallup Center on Healthcare in America reports that 25% of Americans have used AI chatbots for health information. In addition to ChatGPT, users seek medical advice from Google, Microsoft and Anthropic chatbots.

“This isn’t an isolated incident,” Murray said in a statement to The Seattle Times. “Chatbots are not doctors, they’re not nurses, they don’t have experience caring for patients, they’re not reviewed by the (U.S. Food and Drug Administration) for safety and effectiveness.”

# Gemini 4 Hydrogen 登場：主打日常編程與高效智慧代理，Gemini App、Google 搜尋同步升級

Google DeepMind 正式發表全新的 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型，旨在將最前端的 AI 智慧帶給所有使用者，並特別針對日常編程與代理式工作流程提供極致的執行速度與效率。隨著 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 新模型推出，不僅全面登陸 AI Studio 與企業端，一般消費者日常使用的 Gemini App 與 Google 搜尋也同步迎來大升級，讓日常查詢、多步驟推理與自動化代理執行變得更快更聰明。

### 核心亮點與多模型協同運作

相較於專門處理高難度、深層長遠推理的旗艦模型 Gemini 4 Carbon 與 Gemini 4 Argon，Hydrogen 則聚焦於高效率的快速執行。在預設的高思考級別下，其在「人工分析智慧指數（Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index）」上的表現甚至超越了 Argon。

為了讓工作團隊能更流暢地結合不同模型的優勢，Google 同時在 Google Antigravity 中推出了 Orchestrator 功能。該功能可在同一個工作階段中，自動在 Carbon 與 Hydrogen 等不同模型間動態切換：

- 開發效能提升：在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 測試中，Orchestrator 達到接近 Carbon 的任務成功率，同時節省了 24% 的資源配額，並加快 19% 的完成時間。
- 分工架構：Carbon 可擔任協調者，而 Hydrogen 則能作為工作與驗證代理，在獨立的工作區中同步建構與測試，大幅縮短專案交付時程。

### 效能全面躍升：開發與企業應用的實質升級

Hydrogen 採用全面平價的定價策略，在橫跨 100萬 Token 的上下文窗口內，每百萬輸入 Token 為 1.50 美元，輸出 Token 則為 7.50 美元。相較於前一代的 Gemini 3.8 Flash，Hydrogen 在多項效能指標上有顯著突破。

執行任務速度提升 2.5 倍，Terminal-Bench 4.1 分數提升超過三倍（57% 對比 18.2%），並將錯誤宣告降低 5 倍以上；程式碼反覆迭代與除錯部分，擅長進行精準的程式碼修復、程式庫問答與自動化測試，在處理圖形、SQL 與企業大數據工作流程時，執行速度比 3.8 Flash 快上 2 到 2.8 倍，且能減少 12% 至 23% 的 Token 用量。

另外，結合 100 萬 Token 輸入與高達 100 萬 Token 的輸出能力，能將密集的 PDF、試算表、圖表、音訊與影片轉化為結構化的專業報告。

### 四種思考級別與安全性防護

為了兼顧品質、延遲與成本，Gemini 4 Hydrogen 提供低、中、高（預設）以及全新的極高（xhigh）等四種思考級別。使用者可依據任務所需的推理深度，靈活調整運算資源。

在安全性方面，Hydrogen 導入了最新的 Gemini 4 安全防護網，包括：代理任務的過度擴權減少高達 81%，並大幅降低工具使用與程式碼評估中的失誤。在面對無法執行的任務時，更不易跨越權限邊界。而在 Gray Swan IPI 評估中，其對抗間接提示詞注入攻擊的能力提升了 2.3 倍以上。

Gemini 4 Hydrogen 即日起在全球陸續推出，涵蓋開發者、企業與一般消費者端：

- 開發者：可透過 AI Studio 與 Android Studio 的 Gemini API 進行建構；付費訂閱者亦可在 Google Antigravity 中體驗。
- 企業用戶：可在 Gemini for business 的 API 或模型選單、Google Antigravity，以及符合資格的 Google 試算表（Google Sheets）中部署。
- 一般大眾：即日起可在 Gemini App 模型選單與 Google Search 中使用，並將逐步推廣至 Google 試算表中。

Google.title: 谷歌新Gemini 4，跑分超Argon，搜索引擎上免费用 - 今日头条
Google.description: 谷歌新Gemini 4，跑分超Argon，搜索引擎上免费用 ... 11 月 12 日，谷歌正式发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，并同步推出了多模型智能调度系统 Orchestrator。 这是一个 Flash 级别的大模型（也是 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的继任者） ... 但根据 Gemini 新的命名方式谷歌为其选用了全新的 Hydrogen（氢）作为级别名称 ... https://deepmind.google/models/model-cards/gemini-4-hydrogen/
Google.content:
# 谷歌新Gemini 4，跑分超Argon，搜索引擎上免费用

一觉醒来，谷歌又发 Gemini 4 模型了。

11 月 12 日，谷歌正式发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，并同步推出了多模型智能调度系统 Orchestrator。

这是一个 Flash 级别的大模型（也是 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的继任者），原生多模态，输入、思考和输出共享 100 万 token 窗口，但根据 Gemini 新的命名方式谷歌为其选用了全新的 Hydrogen（氢）作为级别名称。

在 Gemini 4 产品矩阵中，Carbon 和 Argon 专注于深度推理与复杂任务，而 Hydrogen 则扮演「快速执行引擎」的角色。Hydrogen 主打高效运行、快速响应，非常适合日常编码、智能体（Agentic）工作流以及多步骤数据处理。

在多项基准测试上，Hydrogen 在知识工作、自动化和代码修复任务上很有竞争力：

它对标的是 Anthropic 的 Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 OpenAI 的 GPT-6.1 Terra。在涉及复杂图计算、SQL 查询以及高并发企业级数据工作流的实测中，Hydrogen 的运行速度较前代提升了 2-2.8 倍；同时在需要跨模态理解长视频、大型代码库（百万级上下文满载）时，首字延迟（TTFT）依然保持在较低水平。

在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上，Hydrogen 默认 high 档得到了 51 分，最高 xhigh 档为 54 分，这个成绩还超过了谷歌自己更大参数的 Argon（50 分）。

可见 Hydrogen 模型增加了一个 xhigh 推理强度。谷歌建议主要任务从 high 开始，只有遇到困难的多步问题时再使用 xhigh，因为后者可能增加延迟、token 消耗，并在简单任务上过度思考。

借助 Hydrogen 模型，谷歌将 Gemini 4 系列大幅推广，让所有人都可以用上，包括所有级别的 Google AI Studio、Gemini API、Gemini for Business、Gemini 应用、Google 搜索，以及 Google Antigravity 中的付费 Google AI Pro 和 Ultra 订阅用户。

不过不同入口的开放方式有所区别。在 Gemini 应用中，免费用户通过 Auto 自动模型选择获得 Hydrogen 的响应，Google AI Plus、Pro 和 Ultra 用户则可以手动选择。开发者可以使用 AI Studio 和 Gemini API 的免费层，但受到速率限制。

Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的 API 每百万输入 token 价格为 1.5 美元，缓存命中 0.075 美元，输出 token 7.5 美元。

谷歌表示，在实际软件开发过程中，开发者虽然需要使用 Carbon 和 Argon 级别的前沿模型进行深入的架构判断，以设计系统或解决细微的 bug，但仍然需要一个快速、规范的执行模型来进行代码编写、运行测试和验证变更。Hydrogen 的设计初衷是既可以作为日常工作的独立模型，也可以与 Carbon 和 Argon 结合使用，作为多模型工作流中的高效执行引擎。

为了帮助实现这种多模型协作的自动化，谷歌在自己的编程工具 Google Antigravity 中引入了 Orchestrator，该机制可在同一会话中动态切换 Carbon 和 Hydrogen 等模型。在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 测试中，Orchestrator 的任务成功率接近 Carbon，平均消耗的配额能减少 24%，完成速度提升 19%。对于需要并行 Agent 的工作流，Carbon 可以作为协调器，而 Hydrogen 可以为工作代理和验证代理提供支持，从而在隔离的工作区中同时构建和测试变更，帮助团队更快地交付复杂项目，而不会增加 token 成本。

Orchestrator 功能已首先向 Ultra 用户推出。

除了多模型工作流之外，Hydrogen 相对 Gemini 3.8 Flash 也是一次重大独立升级。它在速度和智能方面都实现了显著提升：在高默认设置下，任务完成速度提升了 2.5 倍，Terminal-Bench 4.1 得分提高了三倍多（57% 对比 18.2%），幻觉减少了 5 倍以上，并且在工具调用失败或搜索结果为空时能够无缝适应。

效率提升也体现在模型使用工具的方式上。探索大型代码库时，Hydrogen 能够将文件读取与搜索调用批量并行执行，减少逐个查看文件带来的等待。在缺少必要上下文时，它也更倾向于指出信息缺口，而不是猜测。

谷歌展示了一个更直观的办公案例：在 Antigravity 中给 Hydrogen 一段 YouTube 主题演讲视频和一个设计模板，它能直接在 Google Slides 中生成多页演示文稿，随后自行检查并修正文字重叠等排版问题。从理解视频、组织内容，到调用应用和检查结果，多模态能力贯穿了整个任务。

Hydrogen 这个比 3.8 Flash 还要快是什么感觉？似乎已经不好形容了。谷歌现在已经把 Hydrogen 用作搜索引擎 AI Mode 默认的模型，同时用它来支撑搜索主界面中 AI Overviews 复杂查询的底层推理，为全球所有用户提供更实用、更直观的搜索结果。

通过 Hydrogen 模型，人们可以按照自然的思路向搜索框提出问题，即使你的查询包含多个部分、难以理解的拼写错误或非常具体的要求，搜索也能智能地理解你正在寻找的内容。在搜索结果中，你将获得 AI 生成的高度自适应、视觉化且易于浏览的反馈。

借助 Hydrogen 的先进推理技术，谷歌还升级了搜索中的查询扇出（Query Fan-Out，LLM 将复杂问题拆解并行，分别检索生成，最后合并的机制），为人们提供比以往更广泛的有用链接，可以找到以前没有发现的网站。

随着 Hydrogen 的加入，Gemini 4 已经覆盖了谷歌的全家桶，现在更多人可以享受到前沿 AI 了。

# New Google AI mode cuts hallucinations and gives faster responses

When you buy through links on our articles, Future and its syndication partners may earn a commission.

Google has announced its latest AI model, Gemini 4 Hydrogen. The model replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash that most consumers will currently be using, with Google promising significant performance upgrades.

That's going to be most apparent in the Gemini app, where paid subscribers can move over to Hydrogen, which should be better at staying on task, following instructions and making for a better daily assistant. Those on the free AI tier will move to Hydrogen when needed, switching over from Flash-Lite.

Advertisement

Advertisement

It will sit alongside Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon, which are designed for more complicated tasks and coding. Hydrogen, on the other hand, is for everything that you want to happen quickly.

While much of Gemini 4 Hydrogen's skills are aimed at developers - which is where the reports of higher performance, greater speed, multi-agent handling and lower hallucination rates are all promised - for consumers, one of the big changes will be to Google Search.

Gemini 4 Hydrogen will power AI Mode in Google Search moving forward. That should make it faster to get the results you want, with more accuracy. Google says that it's better at understanding exactly what you want, sidestepping things like typos and multi-part queries.

With Google now slipping from AI Overviews into AI Mode on many searches, Hydrogen will make these searches more visual, bringing in scannable responses to help your understanding. It will also be better at understanding natural language.

Advertisement

Advertisement

There's also the promise that more relevant links will be included. This is an area that's caused huge concern for publishers, with AI Mode generally answering the question from harvested information rather than sending users through to the source information that answers the query.

That's had a massive impact on the pages that publishers are serving up, but Google says that Hydrogen will provide more links. Whether that will see more clickthrough or not - especially if Gemini is better at answering the question - remains to be seen.

On top of this, Google says that Gemini 4 Hydrogen offers better security, keeping Gemini on task rather than it running off to do other things outside its permission sets. Equally, it's more resilient to injection attacks.

Google Gemini 4 Hydrogen is available now and rolling out immediately.

Meta.content:
# Meta Model API

The Meta Model API (public preview) serves Meta Superintelligence Labs' Muse Spark models through an OpenAI-compatible API. The Meta provider extends the OpenAI provider and supports its compatible options.

note

This provider uses the Meta Model API atapi.meta.ai for Muse models. Meta retired the separate Llama API at api.llama.com on July 6, 2026.

## Setup

- Create an API key from the API keys tab on the Meta Model API dashboard.
- Set theMODEL_API_KEY environment variable, or specify apiKey or a custom apiKeyEnvar in your config.

providers:
  - id: meta:muse-spark-1.3

meta:<model> defaults to the Responses API — Meta's full-feature surface and the one its docs recommend. Use meta:chat:<model> for the OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, or meta:messages:<model> for the Anthropic-compatible Messages API. If you omit the model, the provider defaults to muse-spark-1.1; select muse-spark-1.3 explicitly to use the latest model.

## Available Models

Check the models page for the live list. As of writing:

- muse-spark-1.3 — latest model for coding and agentic workflows, with a 1,048,576-token context window, text/image/video/PDF input, tool calling, structured output, and search grounding.
- muse-spark-1.3-contributor — the same model with discounted pricing. Selecting this ID permits Meta to use your prompts and completions to train future models.
- muse-spark-1.1 — original Muse Spark model, still supported.

Both 1.3 IDs work with the Responses, Chat Completions, and Messages APIs. Meta notes that audio understanding in 1.3 is not fully supported and may produce degraded responses.

## Configuration
providers:
  - id: meta:muse-spark-1.3
    config:
      reasoning_effort: high
      max_completion_tokens: 8192
      temperature: 1.0

### Configuration Options

The provider accepts compatible OpenAI provider options. Notable behavior:

- reasoning_effort — minimal, low, medium, high, or xhigh. When omitted, the model picks its own reasoning depth. Muse Spark does not support none; the provider rejects it with a clear error. Reasoning tokens bill at the output rate and count toward the output cap.
- max_completion_tokens — caps generation on the chat endpoint (Meta accepts max_tokens only as a deprecated alias; if you set it, the provider forwards it as the canonical max_completion_tokens). On the Responses API the cap is max_output_tokens, and the provider maps max_completion_tokens/max_tokens onto it. When unset, no cap is sent so reasoning can use the full output budget.
- temperature — supported (0–2, API default 1.0). Promptfoo sends its deterministic default of 0 unless you override it.
- response_format — structured output with guaranteed JSON schema matching.
- tools / tool_choice — parallel tool calling with streamed arguments.
- prompt_cache_retention — in_memory or 24h for prompt caching; cached prompt tokens bill at the cached-input rate.
- seed — best-effort determinism.

On Chat Completions and Responses, promptfoo rejectslogprobs, n > 1, stop, and logit_bias before sending a request. It also rejects stream because these integrations expect a complete JSON response. OpenAI-scoped environment defaults (OPENAI_TEMPERATURE, OPENAI_TOP_P, OPENAI_MAX_COMPLETION_TOKENS, penalty variables) are not applied to Meta requests.

### Cost Tracking

Promptfoo computes token cost from Meta's published pricing, including the discounted rate for cached input:

Model | Input / 1M | Cached input / 1M | Output / 1M 
---|---|---|---
muse-spark-1.3, muse-spark-1.1 | $1.25 | $0.15 | $4.25 
muse-spark-1.3-contributor | $0.10 | $0.002 | $0.20 

Contributor pricing requires opting into Meta's training data terms by selecting the Contributor model ID. Override token prices withcost, inputCost, outputCost, or cacheReadCost (USD per token) for custom rates. Token cost excludes web-search charges.

## Responses API

meta:<model> (the default) and meta:responses:<model> target Meta's /v1/responses endpoint — the only Meta endpoint that carries reasoning across turns, with built-in web-search grounding:
providers:
  - id: meta:responses:muse-spark-1.3
    config:
      reasoning_effort: medium
      tools:
        - type: web_search

Withweb_search, the model grounds answers in real-time web results with inline citations. Web search bills separately ($2.50 per 1,000 queries) and is not included in promptfoo's computed token cost.

## Messages API

meta:messages:<model> targets Meta's Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint (https://api.meta.ai/v1/messages) — the surface Anthropic-format coding agents such as Claude Code use. Use it to evaluate Muse Spark over the same wire format those agents send:
providers:
  - id: meta:messages:muse-spark-1.3
    config:
      max_tokens: 8192

The provider extends the Anthropic provider, so its options (max_tokens, tools, image and document content blocks, etc.) apply. It defaults max_tokens to 131,072 and enables streaming so the Anthropic SDK can safely handle long generations; streamed output is aggregated before grading. Authentication uses your Meta key as a bearer token (Authorization: Bearer), matching Meta's docs — Anthropic-scoped settings like ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS, ANTHROPIC_TEMPERATURE, custom headers, and Claude Code OAuth credentials are deliberately ignored on this surface.

Muse Spark's reasoning arrives on this surface as encryptedredacted_thinking blocks, so the provider defaults showThinking to false to keep the ciphertext out of graded output.

## Using with coding-agent providers

Meta positions Muse Spark as a backend for coding agents, and promptfoo's agentic providers can evaluate those setups end to end. In both recipes, setapiKey explicitly: the agent subprocesses inherit your shell environment, and an explicit key guarantees your Meta key is used instead of an ambient OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY that belongs to another service.

### Codex CLI

Theopenai:codex-sdk provider drives Muse Spark over the Responses API:
providers:
  - id: openai:codex-sdk
    config:
      base_url: https://api.meta.ai/v1
      model: muse-spark-1.3
      apiKey: '{{env.MODEL_API_KEY}}'

The explicitapiKey is required — the provider does not read MODEL_API_KEY on its own, and without it an ambient OPENAI_API_KEY would be sent to the Meta endpoint instead.

### Claude Code

Theanthropic:claude-agent-sdk provider forwards config.env to the agent subprocess. Pass the environment Meta's guide prescribes, with apiKey set to your Meta key:
providers:
  - id: anthropic:claude-agent-sdk
    # Provider-level `env` outranks the eval's top-level `env`, pinning the
    # routing values a suite-wide ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (e.g. an Anthropic
    # gateway) would otherwise override — which would send the Meta key there.
    env:
      ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: https://api.meta.ai
      ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS: ''
    config:
      apiKey: '{{env.MODEL_API_KEY}}'
      env:
        ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: https://api.meta.ai
        ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: '{{env.MODEL_API_KEY}}'
        ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS: ''
        ANTHROPIC_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH: 'true' # Claude Code disables MCP tool search for non-first-party hosts

warning

Do not omitapiKey, the empty ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS override, or the provider-level env block. The provider forwards its resolved API key into the agent subprocess as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY after env: is applied — if apiKey is unset and a real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is exported in your shell, that Anthropic credential would be transmitted to Meta's endpoint. Clearing ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS prevents an inherited gateway or proxy secret from being sent to Meta. The provider-level env block matters because the subprocess environment is layered process.env < config.env < provider/suite env: without the pin, a top-level env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL in the same config would silently re-route the agent — and your Meta key — to that URL.

Pin every model alias as shown — Claude Code otherwise routes background tasks, Plan Mode, or subagents to Claude models the Meta API doesn't serve. See Meta's coding agents guide for the full setup pattern.

## Example Usage
providers:
  - id: meta:muse-spark-1.3
  - id: openai:gpt-5.5

prompts:
  - 'Summarize the following in one sentence: {{text}}'

tests:
  - vars:
      text: 'Promptfoo is an open-source tool for testing and evaluating LLM apps.'

Get started with a runnable example:
npx promptfoo@latest init --example provider-meta

## API Details

- Base URL:https://api.meta.ai/v1 (override with apiBaseUrl; the Messages surface uses the bare host https://api.meta.ai).
- OpenAI-compatible chat completions (/chat/completions) and Responses (/responses) endpoints, plus the Anthropic-compatible Messages (/messages) endpoint.
- Rate limits apply per team, not per key: 3,000 RPM / 4M TPM for Standard models and 100 RPM / 3M TPM for Contributor models.
- Full API documentation.

Muse Wonder est un grand modèle de langage de Meta, disponible sur l'API Venice sousmuse-wonder. Les requêtes sont anonymisées, le fournisseur ne voit donc jamais votre identité.

Muse Wonder est un modèle de raisonnement de pointe de Meta, conçu pour les tâches agentiques personnelles et professionnelles complexes. Il accepte du texte, des images, de la vidéo, de l'audio et des documents PDF, et renvoie du texte, avec une fenêtre de contexte de 1M tokens. DeepSeek.content:
DeepSeek 全家桶应用 API 已发布：联网搜索、文件输入、阅读链接、模型安全、ASR、TTS 等，点此查看使用指南

# DeepSeek 发布全家桶应用 API

在 DeepSeek App（含网页端）的对话服务中，联网搜索、文件输入、阅读链接、语音交互及安全等能力与模型推理相互配合，构成了用户熟悉的对话体验。而开发者如果想要在应用中实现类似功能，除接入原有 DeepSeek API 外，往往还需耗费大量精力去对接外部工具、处理调用衔接。

今天，我们正式开放这套全家桶应用 API：在原有 API 中开启对应参数，即可获得深度思考搜索、文件输入等对话功能；语音及相关底层能力也已开放独立接口（含 OCR、ASR、TTS 等），支持单独或组合调用。开发者可以在自己的应用中轻松实现复杂的对话功能，甚至 1:1 复刻出完整的 DeepSeek App。

## 全面开放应用功能，支持独立调用

本次更新将 DeepSeek App 的各项交互功能直接整合进原有 API。开启对应参数后，相关工具调用与上下文拼接均由服务端自动完成。目前，V4.1-Flash 模型（deepseek-flash）已在 Messages、Responses 与 Chat Completions 接口下支持以下能力：

- 联网搜索：在非思考模式下，打开deepseek_web_search 工具后，模型可根据提问自动发起网页或图片搜索并附引用作答；
- 深度思考搜索：在思考模式下，打开deepseek_web_search 工具后，模型可在多步推理中自主联网搜索与阅读链接；
- 文件输入：支持上传 PDF、Office、图片等格式的文件，完成纯文本提取或图文混排解析后，拼入对话上下文供模型作答；
- 阅读链接：将deepseek_read_url 工具打开后，模型可自动识别用户消息中的链接，抓取网页内容并结合上下文作答；
- 模型安全：开启安全校验参数后，我们将提供基础风控，审核模型输入输出，命中风险时返回拒答标识。如您对外提供应用服务，请务必开启该参数，并承担内容安全审核、大模型登记、AI 标识等义务。

此外，为方便开发者更灵活地接入自有工作流，上述底层能力及语音能力均支持作为独立接口单独调用，包括：Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS。

使用上述接口，开发者即可实现与 DeepSeek App 基本一致的功能。为直观演示这一效果，我们基于新版 API 构建并开源了一份轻量的前端 Demo，支持直接导入 DeepSeek 历史对话。

更详细的参数定义与调用说明，请参考 DeepSeek 官方 API 文档 API 指南 - 构建 Chatbot。

## API 定价说明

用户调用 DeepSeek API 使用扩展能力时，除收取 Token 费用外，也将收取相关工具的调用费用。各项工具价格如下表所示：

# DeepSeek 工具 API 定价

| 项目 | 价格 |

| 文字 / 图片搜索 | 5 元/千次 |

| 网页抓取 | 5 元/千次 |

| 文字识别 | 1.5 元/千页 |

| 语音识别 | 0.39 元/小时 0.78 元/小时 限时5折 |

| 语音合成 | 1.5 元/万字符 3.0 元/万字符 限时5折 |

注：语音识别 与 语音合成 当前处于限时 5 折优惠期

(划线价为刊例价)

## 写在后面的话

我们相信，人与模型的交互依然充满无限可能，而 DeepSeek 现有的对话产品只是较为基础的一种形态。

现在，官方产品背后的各项能力均已支持通过 DeepSeek API 随心调用、自由组合，我们期待开发者能够借此省去重复的基础工作，打造出更多样、更极致、更具想象力的产品。

欢迎使用 DeepSeek API，尽情创造。

DeepSeek.content:
The full suite of DeepSeek application APIs is now available: web search, file input, URL reading, model safety, ASR, TTS and more. Click here to view the guide

# The full DeepSeek App experience, now via API

Search, files, links, safety, and voice. The capabilities behind the DeepSeek App are now available through the DeepSeek API. Enable built-in features with a few parameters, or call standalone APIs such as OCR, ASR, and TTS. Build richer conversations or recreate the full DeepSeek App in your own application.

Try our open-source frontend demo, with support for importing DeepSeek conversation history.

## 🛠️ Built-in tools. Flexible APIs.

V4.1-Flash (deepseek-flash) now supports these capabilities across Messages, Responses, and Chat Completions, with tool calls and context assembly handled server-side:

🔹 Web Search: Search the web or images with citations in non-thinking mode.

🔹 Deep Thinking Search: Search and read pages throughout multi-step reasoning.

🔹 File Input: Parse PDFs, Office files, images, and more into conversation context.

🔹 URL Reading: Automatically fetch links in user messages to inform answers.

🔹 Safety Checks: Screen inputs and outputs, returning refusal indicators when risks are detected.

Enable search withdeepseek_web_search and URL reading with deepseek_read_url. Public-facing apps must enable safety checks. Developers remain responsible for content moderation, applicable model registration, and AI-generated content labeling.

Search, Fetch, OCR, ASR, and TTS are also available as standalone APIs for custom workflows.

## 💰 API pricing

Extended capabilities incur tool usage fees in addition to standard token charges. See the tool pricing breakdown below.

# DeepSeek Tool API Pricing

## Tool Price

Search $ 0.75 / 1K requests

Fetch $ 0.75 / 1K requests

OCR $ 0.225 / 1K pages

ASR $ 0.058 / hour 50% OFF

$ 0.116 / hour Limited time

TTS $ 0.225 / 10K characters 50% OFF

$ 0.45 / 10K characters Limited time

## 🌱 More possibilities, ready to build

The DeepSeek App is just one way to interact with AI. Its capabilities are now yours to call and combine freely. Spend less time rebuilding the basics and more time creating something new.

Build with DeepSeek. Let your imagination lead.
