DeepSeek.content:
The full suite of DeepSeek application APIs is now available: web search, file input, URL reading, model safety, ASR, TTS and more. Click here to view the guide

# Change Log

## Date: 2026-11-13

### Releasing the full suite of application APIs

In the DeepSeek App (including the web version), web search, file input, URL reading, voice interaction and safety work together with model inference to form the conversation experience users know. Today we open these capabilities to developers: enable the corresponding parameters in the existing APIs to get conversation features such as web search, file input and URL reading, with the tool calls and context assembly handled by the service.

Thedeepseek-flash model supports the following in the Messages, Responses and Chat Completions APIs:

- Web search: with thinking disabled and thedeepseek_web_search tool enabled, the model runs web or image searches as the question requires and answers with citations.
- Deep thinking search: with thinking enabled and thedeepseek_web_search tool enabled, the model searches the web and reads links on its own over multiple reasoning steps.
- File input: upload PDFs, Office files, images, and more; after plain-text extraction or rich-layout parsing, they are added to the conversation context for the model to answer from.
- URL reading: with thedeepseek_read_url tool enabled, the model detects links in the user message, fetches the pages and answers with them in context.
- Model safety: with the safety check parameter enabled, we provide basic risk control: the model input and output are reviewed, and a refusal marker is returned when a risk is found. If you provide a service to the public, enable this parameter and fulfill obligations such as content safety review, large model registration and AI labeling.

In addition, these underlying capabilities and the voice capabilities are available as standalone APIs, including Search and Fetch, OCR, ASR and TTS.

We have also built and open-sourced a demo chat client on these APIs, which can import your DeepSeek chat history; see Demo.

See Build a Chatbot for how to use them, and Models & Pricing for prices.

## Date: 2026-10-17

### Opening up the in-house search API

DeepSeek's web and API search capabilities are powered by our in-house DeepSeek search engine, which reliably handles hundreds of millions of search requests from around the world every day. DeepSeek Search is an AI-native general-purpose search engine that indexes hundreds of billions of web pages, supports multilingual search, and returns highly relevant, authoritative, and timely results in real time. It filters SEO spam, GEO manipulation, and low-quality AIGC through strict detection mechanisms, ensuring authoritative and trustworthy information for users and LLMs. For usage details, see the Search & Fetch guide.

### DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 Update

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has been upgraded to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. The official web and APP models have also been updated to the new version. The API calling method and pricing remain unchanged — simply usedeepseek-flash to access the latest model.

Compared with the previous DeepSeek V4.1, the new model delivers substantial improvements across benchmarks:

- HLE (w/o tools): 42.6 (44.0*)
- Terminal-Bench 4.0: 42.3
- DeepSWE v1.1: 77.0
- ProgramBench: 29.1
- NL2Repo-Bench: 68.2
- Automation-Bench v1.0.6: 60.5
- Agents' Last Exam: 35.4
- Apex Bench v1.1: 72.1
- Chartography (w/tools): 83.0
- BabyVision (w/tools): 92.5
- ZeroBench-main (w/tools): 51.0

* Tested only on the pure-text subset of the HLE benchmark set. Terminal-Bench 4.0 was tested with the Claude Code framework, and DeepSWE with the Mini-SWE-V2 framework. ZeroBench-main was evaluated with Pass@5.

While improving performance, we also reduced the model's task runtime and output length, enabling users to complete tasks at lower cost and higher speed and achieving a new performance–cost Pareto optimum across multiple harnesses. We specifically optimized for DeepSeek Harness, Tencent CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, and other platforms. Please upgrade to DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 or later for the best experience with the new model.

## Date: 2026-09-10

### DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Release

Today, we officially release the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model. It is the smallest model in our new architecture family, with native multimodal visual understanding. The new architecture is designed for a higher capability ceiling, faster inference, higher throughput, and scaling to larger models.

- GPQA Diamond: 90.9
- HLE: 36.8 (39.1*)
- Codeforces (Rating): 3471
- MathArena Apex: 65.6
- Terminal-Bench 2.1: 90.6
- Terminal-Bench 3.0: 30.0
- Terminal-Bench 4.0: 31.2
- DeepSWE v1.1: 74.2
- ProgramBench: 20.3
- NL2Repo-Bench: 65.4
- CyberGym: 88.1
- SEC-Bench Pro: 62.8
- ExploitGym: 15.3
- HLE (w/tools): 63.9
- Automation-Bench: 54.8
- Agents' Last Exam: 31.8
- Chartography (w/tools): 78.9
- BabyVision (w/tools): 89.6
- ZeroBench-main (w/tools): 49.0

API changes

* Tested only on the pure-text subset of the HLE benchmark set.

DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now available on the DeepSeek API with native multimodal support. Change the model name todeepseek-flash to call the latest V4.1 Flash model. The previous-generation models V4 Flash and V4 Flash Vision Exp have been retired; for compatibility, the model names deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are temporarily routed to V4.1 Flash.

In response to user demand, we have decided to continue providing API services for DeepSeek V4 Pro after September 14, 2026, with the billing method remaining unchanged. We will provide further notice should there be any changes. Thank you for your understanding and support!
API pricing adjustment
With the release of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, API prices have been reduced accordingly. For details, please refer to Models & Pricing.

For more details, please refer to this documentation.

## Date: 2026-08-21

### DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp Release

Today, the new multimodal vision understanding model DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp is now available on the DeepSeek API platform. This is an experimental model that can be accessed by settingmodel='deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp'.

- Terminal Bench 2.1: 83.9
- NL2Repo: 57.7
- DeepSWE: 59.3
- DSBench-Hard: 63.6
- AutomationBench (Public): 25.7
- ApexBench (Pass@1): 36.5
- Agents' Last Exam: 27.3
- Chartography: 64.3
- ZeroBench (Pass@5): 35.0

* For the Code Agent text tasks in the public benchmark sets, the DeepSeek family models were tested using the DeepSeek Harness minimal mode as the framework, with the max effort level, topp=0.95, and temperature=1.0; in the ApexBench and Agents' Last Exam evaluations, the text model DeepSeek-V4-Flash ignores the multimodal elements within them.

In terms of pure-text capabilities (agent, reasoning, world knowledge, etc.), DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp is on par with the official DeepSeek-V4-Flash.

On agent benchmarks that require visual understanding, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp delivers a significant leap over DeepSeek-V4-Flash, bringing its multimodal agent capabilities close to Opus-4.8.

For usage details, please refer to the Vision guide.

## Date: 2026-08-13

### DeepSeek-V4-Pro Update

The GA release of DeepSeek-V4-Pro has been rolled out on the APP, Web, and API. The API calling method remains unchanged — simply set the model name todeepseek-v4-pro to use the latest version.

The GA version of DeepSeek V4 Pro greatly enhances agent capabilities, with particularly significant performance improvements in production environments.

- HLE (wo / w tools): 42.7/60.0
- Terminal Bench 2.1: 87.9
- NL2Repo: 61.5
- Cybergym: 83.3
- DeepSWE: 62.7
- Toolathlon-Verified: 74.1
- Agents' Last Exam: 25.7
- AutomationBench (Public): 31.8
- DSBench-FullStack: 71.1
- DSBench-Hard: 67.2

The DeepSeek API now natively supports the OpenAI Responses API format and is specifically adapted for Codex. Users can refer to the official documentation and complete the Codex configuration with a one-click configuration script.
More flexible thinking effort control
The thinking modes of V4-Pro and V4-Flash now support three thinking effort levels: low / high / max. In real-world usage, users can flexibly choose based on task complexity: use low for simple tasks, high for daily Agent tasks, and max for more complex scenarios. For setup instructions, please refer to the official API documentation: Thinking Mode.
API Pricing Adjustment
With the official release of the DeepSeek V4 model family, we will update and adjust API pricing. To allocate resources more reasonably, we will adopt peak/off-peak pricing, with off-peak prices set at half of the peak-hour prices, encouraging users to schedule their tasks based on actual usage. # DeepSeek开放“全家桶”应用API：开发者可1:1复刻完整DeepSeek App

凤凰网科技讯（编辑/云飞） 11月13日，DeepSeek宣布正式开放“全家桶”应用API，将DeepSeek App中的联网搜索、文件输入、阅读链接、语音交互及安全校验等能力整合进原有API，开发者开启对应参数即可在自有应用中实现复杂对话功能，甚至1:1复刻完整DeepSeek App。

# DeepSeek 发布全家桶应用 API
原创 深度求索 DeepSeek 2026年11月13日 22:19 北京
在 DeepSeek App（含网页端）的对话服务中，联网搜索、文件输入、阅读链接、语音交互及安全等能力与模型推理相互配合，构成了用户熟悉的对话体验。而开发者如果想要在应用中实现类似功能，除接入原有 DeepSeek API 外，往往还需耗费大量精力去对接外部工具、处理调用衔接。
今天，我们正式开放这套全家桶应用 API：在原有 API 中开启对应参数，即可获得深度思考搜索、文件输入等对话功能；语音及相关底层能力也已开放独立接口（含 OCR、ASR、TTS 等），支持单独或组合调用。开发者可以在自己的应用中轻松实现复杂的对话功能，甚至 1:1 复刻出完整的 DeepSeek App。
## 全面开放应用功能，支持独立调用
本次更新将 DeepSeek App 的各项交互功能直接整合进原有 API。开启对应参数后，相关工具调用与上下文拼接均由服务端自动完成。目前，V4.1-Flash 模型（deepseek-flash）已在 Messages、Responses 与 Chat Completions 接口下支持以下能力：
- **联网搜索**：在非思考模式下，打开 deepseek_web_search 工具后，模型可根据提问自动发起网页或图片搜索并附引用作答；
- **深度思考搜索**：在思考模式下，打开 deepseek_web_search 工具后，模型可在多步推理中自主联网搜索与阅读链接；
- **文件输入**：支持上传 PDF、Office、图片等格式的文件，完成纯文本提取或图文混排解析后，进入对话上下文供模型作答；
- **阅读链接**：将 deepseek_read_url 工具打开后，模型可自动识别用户消息中的链接，抓取网页内容并结合上下文作答；
- **模型安全**：开启安全校验参数后，我们将提供基础风控，审核模型输入输出，命中风险时返回报警标识。如您对外提供应用服务，请务必开启该参数，并承担内容安全审核、大模型登记、AI 标识等义务。
此外，为方便开发者更灵活地接入自有工作流，上述底层能力及语音能力均支持作为独立接口单独调用，包括：Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR^、TTS。
DeepSeek

据官方介绍，V4.1-Flash模型（deepseek-flash）已在Messages、Responses与Chat Completions接口下支持联网搜索、深度思考搜索（多步推理中自主联网与阅读链接）、文件输入（PDF、Office、图片等格式）、阅读链接及模型安全校验。相关工具调用与上下文拼接均由服务端自动完成。

此外，上述底层能力及语音能力（Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS）均支持作为独立接口单独调用，便于开发者接入自有工作流。DeepSeek同步开源了轻量前端Demo，支持导入历史对话。定价方面，用户调用扩展能力时，除Token费用外还将收取对应工具调用费用。

# What Is Qwen AI? Alibaba’s Free Assistant, Its Open Models and the Rules for Business Use

— AI ASSISTANT GUIDE 2026

What is Qwen AI?

Alibaba's free assistant, its open models and the rules for business

- App

- Open models

- Privacy

- MCP

BIGLYSALES.COM

AI calling, built and run for you

### Summarize with AI

Qwen AI is Alibaba’s free AI assistant, and it is also a family of AI models that anyone can download.

That second part is why people keep searching for it.

When I checked Google Keyword Planner on November 13, 2026, “qwen ai” was getting between 10,000 and 100,000 US searches a month. Searches for “qwen 4” were up 9,900% year over year.

Qwen is free, and that is where a lot of people stop reading. There is one line in the terms that matters a lot if you run a business. I cover it below.

This guide explains what Qwen is, who runs it, what the app can do, what it costs, where your data goes and the three ways a business can use it. It is the tenth guide in our AI assistant series, after how to use Claude, ChatGPT for teams, how to use Gemini, how to use Copilot, how to use Perplexity, how to use DeepSeek, Meta Muse and Mistral Vibe.

## Key Takeaways

- Qwen is two things from Alibaba, an AI assistant and a family of AI models.
- The assistant is free on the web, iPhone, Android, Mac and Windows.
- Its terms say the app is for private and non-commercial use only.
- A business has two other routes. Use the API from Alibaba Cloud, or run an open model yourself.
- Alibaba released Qwen3.8-27B under the Apache 2.0 license, which allows commercial use.
- The app is run by a Singapore company, and your inputs are processed by Alibaba Cloud in Singapore.
- You can opt out of model training by email.

## Table of contents

## What Qwen AI is

Qwen AI is an assistant you chat with, plus the AI models that power it.

The Qwen home page describes it as “an AI assistant for everyone, powered by the Qwen series models.” It adds that it is free to use and open to all.

So the name covers two things.

- The Qwen app. A chat assistant, like ChatGPT or Claude.
- The Qwen models. The engines underneath. Alibaba publishes several of them so other people can run and build on them.

Keep those two apart as you read. The rules for the app and the rules for the models are very different.

## Who is behind Qwen

Qwen comes from Alibaba, the Chinese technology group. The footer of the Qwen site reads “Powered by Alibaba Cloud.”

The company you deal with as a user is a different name. The Qwen Service Agreement says your contract is with Nth Power Global Tech Singapore Pte. Ltd., a company set up in Singapore.

The same agreement says it is governed by Singapore law. Disputes go to arbitration in Singapore unless your region has its own terms.

That is a real difference from DeepSeek, which I covered in the DeepSeek guide. Both come from Chinese companies. The paperwork is not the same.

## What the Qwen app can do

The Qwen app does much more than answer questions. Here is what its home page and its chat screen listed when I checked on November 13, 2026.

Feature | What it does | A use for it 
---|---|---
Chat | Answers questions and writes drafts | Explaining a contract term in plain words 
Web search | Looks things up online before it answers | Checking today’s facts 
Deep Research | Runs many searches and writes a report | Comparing two tools before you buy 
Agent Mode | Plans a multi-step task and carries it out | A task with several steps 
Web Dev | Builds a web page from a description | A quick landing page mockup 
Create Image | Makes and edits images | A draft graphic for a flyer 
Create Video | Makes short videos | A rough concept clip 
File upload | Reads files, images, video and audio you attach | Summarizing a long PDF 

Qwen describes Deep Research as an agent that runs multi-step searches and writes a summary report. It says work that used to take hours can be done in a few minutes.

Treat that as the company’s claim. Check any report before you act on it.

## Where you can use Qwen

You can use Qwen in a browser, on a phone or on a computer. The download page lists five places.

- On the web at chat.qwen.ai
- In the iPhone app from the App Store
- In the Android app from Google Play
- In a Mac app
- In a Windows app

The phone apps add voice conversations and questions about photos. The desktop apps can chat about your email, screenshots, files and what is on your screen.

Read that last line twice. A desktop app that can see your screen can see customer records too. Close them first.

## The models inside Qwen right now

The Qwen app lets you pick which model answers you. On November 13, 2026, the picker showed three.

Model | How Qwen describes it | When to pick it 
---|---|---
Qwen3.7-Plus | The high-performance model in the Qwen3.7 series, for text and multimodal tasks | Everyday questions. It was the default 
Qwen3.8-Max | The flagship of the Qwen3.8 line | Harder writing and reasoning 
Qwen4-Max-Preview | A preview of the flagship Qwen4 model | Trying the newest model, knowing it may change 

You do not need to study these. Start with the default. Switch to a Max model when an answer feels thin.

The list changes often. Alibaba ships new Qwen versions every few months, so check the picker itself.

## What Qwen costs

The Qwen app is free. Its home page says so in plain words.

There is one thing to watch. The Service Agreement has a full section on subscriptions, plans and fees, with payments through Apple, Google or Stripe. So paid plans exist or are planned.

I did not find a public price list on the Qwen site on November 13, 2026. I will not guess at numbers. If the app offers you a paid plan, the price on your screen is the one that counts.

Way to use it | Cost | Who pays 
---|---|---
Qwen app | Free to use | Nobody, unless you choose a paid plan 
Qwen API from Alibaba Cloud | Pay for what you use | Your business, by usage 
Open Qwen models | Free to download | You pay for the hardware and the person who runs it 

## The rule to read before you use Qwen at work

The free Qwen app is for personal use only. That comes straight from its terms.

The Service Agreement, effective September 10, 2026, says this.

“The Services are for private and non-commercial use only.”

So if you paste a customer list into the free app to write follow-up emails, you are outside the terms you agreed to.

I am not a lawyer, and terms change. Read the current version yourself before you decide. But the plain reading is clear. The app is for you as a person. It is not a work tool.

This does not make Qwen useless for a business. It means a business should use one of the other two routes.

## 3 ways a business can use Qwen

There are three routes, and each has its own rules.

Route | Who runs it | Rules that apply | What you need 
---|---|---|---
The Qwen app | Qwen, in Singapore | Personal and non-commercial use only | An account 
The API from Alibaba Cloud | Alibaba Cloud | Alibaba Cloud’s own business terms | A developer and a cloud account 
An open model you host | You | The model’s license, such as Apache 2.0 | Hardware and a technical person 

### 1. The app, for learning

Use the free app to learn what Qwen is good at. Keep it to your own questions and public information.

### 2. The API, for building

The Qwen site says its API uses a format compatible with the OpenAI API. In plain words, a developer who has built on ChatGPT’s API can switch with small changes.

This route runs through Alibaba Cloud and has its own terms. Have whoever handles your contracts read them before any customer data goes in.

### 3. An open model, for control

This is the route that makes Qwen different. You download a model, run it on your own machine, and your data never leaves your building.

It takes real technical skill. The next section explains what you get.

## Qwen’s open models in plain words

An open model is an AI model the maker lets you download and run yourself.

Most well-known assistants do not work this way. You rent them. With an open model, you hold a copy.

Alibaba does a lot of this. In an August 17, 2026 post, Alibaba Cloud said it has open-sourced more than 460 models, and that they have been downloaded more than 3 billion times.

The one to know is Qwen3.8-27B. Here is what Alibaba and the model’s page on Hugging Face say about it.

- It is released under the Apache 2.0 license. That license allows commercial use.
- It reads images and video as well as text.
- It can run on consumer hardware. Alibaba says a compressed version can run on a laptop.
- It works with common tools for running models, including Ollama and LM Studio.

Not every Qwen model has the same license. Alibaba also released the weights of its much larger Qwen3.8 flagship, and that one comes with separate terms. Read the license on each model’s page before you build on it.

Why would a business bother? Three reasons come up most.

- Privacy. Customer data stays on your own machines.
- Cost control. You pay for hardware, not per message.
- No lock-in. Nobody can change the price or retire the model you depend on.

The trade is work. Someone has to install it, secure it and keep it updated. For a five person company with no IT help, that is usually too much.

Free setup, live fast

Skip the build and get calls going

Bigly Sales runs fully managed AI calling for inbound and outbound, with live transfer to your team. You get a free 30-minute setup, a $1,000 value, and most teams go live within 24 hours.

## Where your data goes and who trains on it

This section is about the Qwen app. If you host an open model yourself, your data stays with you.

All of this comes from the Qwen privacy policy, effective September 7, 2026, and the Service Agreement.

Question | What Qwen’s documents say 
---|---
Who is responsible for my data? | Nth Power Global Tech Singapore Pte. Ltd., a Singapore company 
Who processes what I type? | Alibaba

# 用千问4把“画地为牢”做成互动游戏，我发现……

2026-11-13 14:04:13

作者：有态度的

分享

### 问财摘要

1、阿里发布了新一代大模型Qwen4-Max预览版，并接入多个平台，支持高达1M Tokens的上下文窗口和多模态输入。 2、Qwen4-Max预览版在任务理解和完成、前端工程交付和简单任务执行路径拆解上的表现超出预期，但在复核中发现，当交互指令涉及复杂的二维空间路径寻路或严苛的未披露口径标注时，模型仍存在一些走捷径的细节偏差。

文章提及标的

免责声明：风险提示：本文内容仅供参考，不代表同花顺观点。同花顺各类信息服务基于人工智能算法，如有出入请以证监会指定上市公司信息披露平台为准。如有投资者据此操作，风险自担，同花顺对此不承担任何责任。

图片加载失败

11月11日，阿里正式宣布新一代大模型Qwen4-Max预览版(qwen4-max-preview)发布，首发上线千问AI平台Token Plan。活动期间用户可享限时2折、新用户再享折上5折，算下来最低1折即可抢先体验Qwen4旗舰模型。

虽然不少开源社区开发者心心念念的Qwen4-27B还没亮相，但目前，Qwen4-Max预览版已同步接入千问办公(QwenWork)、Qoder、千问App、QwenStudio等平台，支持高达1M(100万)Tokens的上下文窗口，以及文本、图像、视频原生多模态输入。

目前阿里尚未公布Qwen4-Max预览版的具体参数细节和刷榜成绩。从官方披露的信息来看，Qwen4拥有更深入的世界知识与立体空间感知能力，重点在Coding(复杂编程)和Agentic(智能体操作)两项核心能力上再升级，瞄准的是复杂编程、前端交互设计、专业办公、软件操作等真实干活场景。

网易（HK9999）科技第一时间围绕这些主打特性，用四道涵盖矢量动画、热梗互动游戏（881275）、手绘看图造工具以及多源财报“排雷”的测试题，对Qwen4-Max预览版进行了一轮深度实测。

经过实测，网易（HK9999）科技发现Qwen4-Max预览版在任务理解和完成，特别是前端工程交付和简单任务执行路径拆解上的表现超出预期。它不再只是应付差事地给个粗糙Demo，而是会主动补齐任务中没有交代的细节，比如说网易（HK9999）科技实测任务中的调校控制台、几何闭合判定、甚至门扇开启弧区的碰撞计算。

但同时，在复核中网易（HK9999）科技也发现，当交互指令涉及复杂的二维空间路径寻路或严苛的未披露口径标注时，模型仍存在一些走捷径的细节偏差。

## 经典基准测试：一句提示词，交回带“调校台”的鹈鹕骑行

首先，我们照例用大模型圈最经典的“鹈鹕骑自行车”测试题打头阵，检验它的空间直觉与前端生成成色。我们给出的提示词极其简短：“创建一个HTML，内容是SVG绘制一个鹈鹕骑自行车的2D动画，不需要任何测试。”

面对这句只有二十多个字的指令，Qwen4-Max预览版直接交回了一个名为《鹈鹕骑行俱乐部》的单文件HTML应用。

图片加载失败

图注：《鹈鹕骑行俱乐部》网页截图，可访问：file:///Users/mac/Library/Containers/com.tencent.xinWeChat/Data/Library/Application%20Support/com.tencent.xinWeChat/2.0b4.0.9/beb14f32851b97a698fc485b993195d8/Message/MessageTemp/1ef9513c2e74db95eb01b1d69c4d0796/File/%E9%B9%88%E9%B9%95%E9%AA%91%E8%87%AA%E8%A1%8C%E8%BD%A6.html

这道题原本只考模型能不能画对鹈鹕的大喉囊和自行车架的几何关系，但Qwen4-Max主动做了一次“超纲交付”：

页面不仅有骑行动画，还内置了落日、正午、夜骑和晨雾四个场景预设；配备了车铃、翘前轮(Wheelie)、暂停，以及SVG、PNG导出按钮。

右侧更是直接给出了一个实时控制台，支持调节骑行速度、车轮半径、路面颠簸和海风强度。

为了确认这些滑块是不是“样子货”，我们检查了交付文件的底层源码。源码显示，模型在脚本中写了鹈鹕腿部关节位置的实时计算逻辑(逆运动学近似)，并且当用户拖动滑块改变“车轮半径”时，程序会动态重建自行车的相关部件。这让调大车轮、改变骑行速度之后的动作表现有了真正可检查的代码支撑，而不是简单的画面缩放。

不过，实测也发现在大幅调大鹈鹕体型的同时，车身比例也同时进行了变大，虽然协调但指令遵循并不一致。

## 玩梗互动游戏《画地为牢》：把名场面台词做成指尖游戏

紧接着，结合近期全网刷屏的综艺热梗，我们给Qwen4-Max预览版出了一道前端题，制作一个手机上能玩的中文互动短剧网页《画地为牢》。

图片加载失败

这道题要求模型只用剪影、灯光和字幕，在20–40秒的流程里原样保留两句核心台词：许飞说“我画地为牢啊厉娜”，以及厉娜说“我原谅你了许飞”。剧情必须靠用户亲手“画线”和“擦线”来推进：

图片加载失败

1.用户必须绕着许飞画一个闭合的圈。画半圈、乱点、或者把圈画在厉娜身边都不能触发下一幕；

图片加载失败

2.厉娜走近说出原谅台词后，用户必须在朝向厉娜的一侧擦开足够宽的缺口，让许飞穿过用户实际擦开的地方走到厉娜身边。

图片加载失败

图片：《画地为牢》互动网页截图，可访问file:///Users/mac/Library/Containers/com.tencent.xinWeChat/Data/Library/Application%20Support/com.tencent.xinWeChat/2.0b4.0.9/beb14f32851b97a698fc485b993195d8/Message/MessageTemp/1ef9513c2e74db95eb01b1d69c4d0796/File/%E7%94%BB%E5%9C%B0%E4%B8%BA%E7%89%A2.html

从交付效果来看，模型不仅接住了这个二创热梗，还给出了相当克制的舞台剧质感。开场冷光打在许飞身上，说出“我画地为牢啊厉娜”后提示观众画圈；圈成之后，许飞低头看脚下，厉娜向前走近停在圈外，说出“我原谅你了许飞”，舞台灯光随之转暖，而地上那道手绘的圈依然横亘在两人之间；直到观众擦开一段线，两人最终站进同一束暖光里，结束页浮现出一句颇有余味的文案“牢是画的，门也是”(看到这句话时，也是让人很意外)。

这道题表面看是玩梗，底层考的其实是前端几何判定。我们对生成的源码进行了复核，发现，防作弊判定很扎实。源码中确实编写了几何校验逻辑，会逐一检查用户画线的首尾距离是否足够接近(闭合判定)、许飞的坐标是否在多边形圈内、以及厉娜是否在圈外。在擦线阶段，代码也会单独计算擦除缺口的宽度和朝向角度，擦得太窄或者擦反了方向(背对厉娜)，都会触发单独的错误提示，不会糊里糊涂放行。

但同时，也存在一些细节偏差，在最后一步“许飞沿着缺口走出去”的实现上，模型耍了个小聪明，源码里人物走出时只读取了缺口的横向(X轴)位置，移动路径依然是沿着舞台地面水平走过去。这意味着，如果玩家把缺口擦在圆圈的斜上方，程序虽然能判定缺口有效并触发下一幕，但许飞走过去的路线却未必会精确穿过斜上方的那个缺口。

## 手绘户型图秒变“卧室布局工具”：连开门弧线都算进了碰撞体积

测完了创意互动，我们再来测一个硬核的“多模态看图+实用工具开发”场景。

我让另一个模型生成了一张专门为测试手绘的带尺寸虚构户型图，要求Qwen4-Max预览版按真实比例重建房间、窗、门的开启区域、暖气和柱子，并放进一张150×200cm的床、一张120×60cm的书桌和一个80×60cm的衣柜。同时要求支持拖动、90度旋转、导出厘米坐标与本地保存，且“越出房间、压住固定设施、互相重叠或挡门时要明确提醒，不能把不合格布局当成合格”。

图片加载失败

模型交付的单文件HTML准确还原了手绘图上的所有空间参数：画出了4米×5米的房间、180厘米的窗、40厘米见方的柱子、暖气片以及90厘米的内开门，尺寸与原图完全一致，并在页面中预置了床、书桌、衣柜以及拖动、旋转、坐标编辑、本地保存和导出面板。

为了检验它写的碰撞检测到底灵不灵，我们直接把交付文件中的核心校验函数单独提取出来，跑了四组边界测试输入：

1.书桌侵入门扇活动区 函数准确拦截，返回“挡门”报错；

2.家具压住暖气片坐标 函数准确拦截，返回压住暖气的对应提示；

3.书桌与床坐标重叠 两件家具同时收到重叠提示；

4.输入合规的摆放坐标 校验通过，没有任何误报。

图片加载失败

这道题最值得称赞的细节，是模型对“门扇开启区”的处理。很多模型看户型图，只会把门当成墙上的一条线段；而Qwen4-Max预览版把原图上表示开门方向的弧线，在代码里真正写成了一个参与碰撞计算的四分之一圆(扇形区域)。也就是说，家具哪怕没有碰到墙体，只要摆在了门扇推开的扫掠弧线内，系统就会判定门打不开并报错。

## 专业办公“反幻觉”测试：把“规模翻倍”和“收入增70%”拆明白了

最后一道题，我们回到日常的专业办公场景，测试模型在面对公司公关话术与财务报表口径冲突时的信息提炼与“反幻觉”能力。

## 我给模型提供了三份虚构材料：

材料A(公司新闻稿)：宣称本季AI业务“规模”达1.20亿元，较上年同期的0.60亿元翻倍(其中含渠道伙伴在终端客户处完成的0.35亿元交易额)。

材料B(财务附注)：按会计口径确认的AI业务收入为0.85亿元(上年同期0.50亿元)；毛利为0.17亿元(上年同期0.15亿元)。

材料C(投资者纪要)：管理层称渠道扩大可能压低了毛利率，但未公布直营和渠道各自的毛利率及客户数。

要求模型以科技记者视角写一段180字以内的快讯导语，用表格列出可直接比较的数字、分母和来源，并交代现有材料能把毛利率变化归因到什么程度。

图片加载失败

## 图片：Qwen4-Max输出的快讯导语与可比数字对照表截图

在这道极易踩坑的财经题上，Qwen4-Max预览版展现出了极强的口径纪律性：

首先，模型没有被新闻稿A里的“翻倍”带偏，导语第一句直接锚定更扎实的财务数据，“按会计口径确认收入0.85亿元，同比增70%(B)”；紧接着挑明新闻稿所称的“规模1.20亿元、同比翻倍”包含0.35亿元渠道伙伴交易额(A)，“口径不同不可直接对比”。

其次，对于数据计算也很准确。模型准确算出毛利额从0.15亿元增至0.17亿元(同比增长约13.3%)；并严格以会计确认收入(0.85亿元和0.50亿元)为分母，算出毛利率从30%降至20%，下滑10个百分点，还在表格中特意提醒“分母为会计口径收入，非1.20亿元规模”。

## 结语：

## 惊喜的部分是替我多想的几步

整体测下来，Qwen4-Max预览版给人的最大惊喜，在于它交付物的工程完整度和逻辑严密性。

无论是《鹈鹕骑行俱乐部》里主动关联车轮半径与腿部关节的计算代码、《画地为牢》里对多边形包裹与擦除缺口朝向的校验，还是《卧室布局工具》里那个实打实参与碰撞检测的四分之一圆开门弧区，都说明Qwen4在Coding和多模态空间理解上，已经从“跑通表面视觉效果”迈向了“构建底层物理与几何规则”。而在面对文字材料的逻辑陷阱时，它对口径差异的敏锐度也足以胜任高要求的案头助理工作。

当然，从《画地为牢》人物走出路径只取横向坐标的“偷懒”写法来看，当单次提示词中包含过多复合空间约束时，模型在个别分支逻辑上仍会出现精度妥协。

# 姚顺雨之后，该刘大一恒交作业了

第四波科技·2026年11月13日 19:07

阿里Qwen4，看什么？

11月11日，千问发布Qwen4-Max预览版，并宣布Qwen4即将正式发布。

从10月开始，关于阿里Qwen4的消息就陆续传出。此前，匿名模型Kalmia现身大模型盲测平台Arena，被广泛猜测是Qwen4；有关其游戏开发能力的内测结果，也在社交媒体上流传。

官方也在持续预热。11月6日，千问发出海报——“北冥有鱼，其名为_”。Qwen4-Max预览版官宣后，千问办公等阿里系产品第一时间接入，正式版尚未发布。

千问称，Qwen4的知识理解更深入、世界感知更立体，开发者内测结果显示，其在3D建模、网页设计、交互等方面表现亮眼。

但同期大模型领域，腾讯已经先行一步。11月4日，姚顺雨掌舵的腾讯混元发布Hy4，宣称跻身最强开源模型之列。接下来，轮到刘大一恒交出答卷了。他手中的Qwen4，能否让千问在新一轮竞争中更进一步，值得关注。

### 01 Qwen4想用大参数追高、小模型补缺？

11月9日，一份游戏开发创造力评估榜单GameFeel Bench在圈内热传：代号hawk的Qwen-4-Flash-Early API在内测中拿到49.9分，压过Opus 5.5 xHigh的47.2分；Qwen-4-27B-Early拿下44.6分，距Sonnet 5.5仅差0.4分。

据称，测试团队在Qwen4正式发布前就拿到了内测API Key，覆盖Flash版和27B部署版。不过，这份第三方榜单仍需谨慎看待。GameFeel Bench在GitHub上只有12颗星，7项评价指标中有4项依赖人工打分，结果难免受主观判断影响。

Qwen4-Max预览版发布后，我们进行了一番实测，并要求它根据第四波科技智库的主题、风格，做一个网站首页页面，首页呈现方式请适配科技智库定位，布局、交互形式请大胆创新。首页栏目包括Deep Brand、智库报告、科技资讯、品牌动态、活动、关于我们等。

（左/Qwen4-Max预览版；右/Hy4）

约10分钟后，Qwen4-Max预览版交付了一版首页。页面结构齐全，还提供了“夜航”和“纸面”两套主题。不过，首屏没有为最新资讯预留板块，主视觉区域（Hero）的标题占据了近三分之一屏，又缺少向下滚动的提示，读者可能停留在首屏便离开。整体来看，作为初稿，这版首页相对完整。

我们又用同样的提示词，让Hy4制作了一版，框架、色系都有不少变化，右侧卡片从品牌相关指数改为公司方法论介绍。就这一次输出而言，Hy4版的页面视觉完成度更高，鼠标跟随、卡片变色、下划浏览等交互细节也做得更丰富（下滑浏览等动态截图未体现）。

这种基础的网页设计其实很难区分模型的上限，我们又尝试让模型视觉化表达“在噪声里识别出信号”：起始是一团无序粒子，逐渐收敛成一条有方向的结构，生成一段5秒左右的3D动画网页。

Qwen4-Max预览版制作

Hy4制作

从画面效果上看，Qwen4-Max预览版生成画面收敛得较粗糙，结尾颜色过曝；Hy4通过一个从左往右移动的旋转光效来表达识别这个过程，相对精致。

榜单和实测只能反映模型的部分能力，上述对比也会有主观的地方。要理解这些表现背后的技术变化，还得看看架构。阿里已于8月26日开源Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，作为Qwen4的架构预览，其技术报告显示，它的激活参数量约为上一代旗舰Qwen3.5-397B-A17B的三分之一，训练Token数量和训练计算量（FLOPs）均约为其九分之一。其用更少的算力，取得接近甚至超过上一代旗舰的测试成绩。

大参数与小模型，对千问是两种意义。

从Qwen3.8-Max的2.4万亿参数，到业内猜测Qwen4的3万亿，再到Qwen4.5、Qwen5规划的5万亿至10万亿，跻身第一梯队绕不开参数竞赛。同时，1.5B、3B、8B、27B等中小参数模型仍在持续开源，把能力铺到闭源体系覆盖不到的地方。刘大一恒在前不久的乌镇峰会上就解释道：头部闭源企业不会关注例如小语种、小众垂类应用、特殊硬件芯片适配等细分领域的问题。这些短板就需要开源中小参数模型补齐。

### 02 同期上线，看什么？

1993年生的刘大一恒与1998年生的姚顺雨同为“90后”技术高管。一位从Qwen早期预训练一路做上来，接任后第一次要为全新一代模型负责；另一位从OpenAI空降腾讯，直接统筹腾讯混元大模型与AI基础设施核心研发工作。

两家的全新一代模型又恰好撞档。早在8月底，26日阿里放出Qwen3.8-Flash-Next提前亮出Qwen4架构，两日后腾讯发布并开源Hy4 preview，两家的新模型对决就已经起手。

9月云栖大会上，接任千问大模型负责人的刘大一恒公布了Qwen4的技术方向：模型RSI自进化、架构更新和多模态交互，并确认Qwen4已在训练。

其中，模型自我改进项，即把递归自我改进（RSI）引入Qwen4的训练流程。任务越长、步骤越多，模型在执行过程中积累的真实反馈数据也越丰富，训练系统便有机会从中筛选出可用于下一轮训练的材料。

不过，RSI并非千问独有，腾讯混元也在探索类似路径。10月，腾讯Hy Frontier团队联合相关学者提出Terminal-RSI训练框架，通过递归训练持续改进终端智能体的执行能力。

作为同期对比的模型，长上下文方面，Hy4与Qwen4预览架构的技术选择颇具代表性。Hy4采用Gated DeepSeek Sparse Attention（Gated DSA），并通过IndexCache跨层复用稀疏索引；Qwen4预览架构则逐层混合使用GDN与QSA，约四分之三的层使用循环状态压缩，其余层负责稀疏注意力检索。前者在稀疏注意力机制内部减少重复计算索引的开销；后者将循环状态压缩与稀疏检索结合，减少需要执行全局注意力的层数。

技术路线之外，两家比拼的另一战场，是谁先走进真实工作场景。刘大一恒强调的全模态能力，不止于“看懂图像、理解视频”，还包括将视觉感知与Agent行动结合，让模型根据现实环境中的信息连续执行任务。

腾讯混元的Hy4则首次引入视觉理解能力，并具备电脑操作（Computer Use）能力，可以结合命令行与图形界面模拟真人操作电脑，完成办公、开发等工作。

模型架构展示了模型处理信息的思路，但对于即将露面的Qwen4来说，它需要证明自己在实际任务中的能力。回归到场景里，用户只看模型能否可靠地调用工具，完成复杂的长程任务，并交付符合要求的结果。

本文来自微信公众号“第四波”，作者：陈俊一，36氪经授权发布。

# Qwen4 is coming! Discover the latest in AI

## API Qwen 3.8 Max {#qwen-3-8-max-api}

Qwen 3.8 Max est un grand modèle de langage développé par Alibaba Qwen, disponible sur l'API Venice sous l'identifiantqwen-3-8-max. Les requêtes sont anonymisées : le fournisseur ne voit jamais votre identité.

Qwen 3.8 Max est le modèle MoE phare d'Alibaba de 2,4 billions de paramètres, avec des progrès majeurs par rapport à Qwen 3.7 Max en ingénierie logicielle et dans les workflows de productivité bureautique, ainsi que de solides performances multi-agents à long horizon. Il accepte le texte et les entrées vision-langage (images et vidéo), fonctionne uniquement en mode réflexion et prend en charge une fenêtre de contexte de 1M tokens.

---|---|---|---

Envoyez vos requêtes àPOST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions avec "model": "qwen-3-8-max" et votre clé API.
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

    "model": "qwen-3-8-max",

  }'

## GLM 5 API {#glm-5-api}

GLM 5 是由 Z.ai 推出的大语言模型，可通过 Venice API 以zai-org-glm-5 调用。它以私密方式运行，零数据留存。

GLM-5 是 GLM-4.7 的后继模型，是由 Z.ai 开发的大语言模型，推理能力显著增强，指令遵循能力有所提升，并支持多种语言。它支持大型上下文窗口，可用于处理大量文本和进行深入分析。

---|---|---|---
zai-org-glm-5 | 标准 | Private | 每 1M $1.00 / $3.20

---|---
提供商 | Z.ai

隐私 | Private

### 如何使用 GLM 5 API {#how-to-use-the-glm-5-api}

使用"model": "zai-org-glm-5" 和您的 API 密钥向 POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions 发送请求。
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "zai-org-glm-5",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "low"
  }'

# ERNIE 5.5 Flash 與 GLM-5.3-FlashX：兩個 Flash 等級，換來截然相反的東西

作者
Rowan Sterling
發佈日期

最新模型 · 20查看全部模型 →

基準測試：Artificial Analysis · 每日更新

返回全部文章

這兩個模型的成本幾乎相同。ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 在百度千帆的定價為每百萬輸入 token 0.28 美元、每百萬輸出 token 1.13 美元；GLM-5.3-FlashX 在 Z.ai API 的定價則為 0.37 美元與 1.25 美元。兩者都宣稱支援百萬 token 上下文，也都作為家族中快速、平價的一端出售。相似之處到此為止，因為這兩家廠商把工程心力投注在相反的問題上。Z.ai 的 GLM-5.3-FlashX 是一個服務層級：權重與 GLM-5.3-Flash 完全相同，模型本身沒有任何改變，而 2.5 倍的價格溢價買到的是吞吐量——在重建的推論堆疊上，最高可達每秒 200 個輸出 token。百度的 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 則是一個檢查點：一個 2,800 億參數的稀疏模型，每個 token 啟用 140 億參數，在後訓練階段中途發布，其推理無法關閉，且公佈的輸出上限為 921,600 個 token。一個賣給你的是更快拿到相同答案；另一個賣給你的是更多思考，並且為這一切全數收費。

這兩款模型都沒有屬於自己的獨立評分。Artificial Analysis 對 GLM-5.3-FlashX 與 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 一律回傳 404。差別在於，FlashX 的能力概況可知，因為它就完全等同於基礎模型的概況，而基礎模型已被測量；ERNIE 的能力概況則完全不可知，因為附在它身上的唯一數字是百度產生的。這種不對稱，比任何一方的價目表更能決定這場比較。

## 「flash」在每個名稱中起什麼作用

在 Z.ai 的命名中，X 代表的是排隊位置。GLM-5.3-FlashX 與 GLM-5.3-Flash 採用相同的主幹：總參數 320B、活躍參數 18B 的混合專家模型；兩者接受相同的文字、圖像、影片與檔案輸入，並回傳相同的 100 萬 token 上下文。Z.ai 對這項變更的說明屬於基礎設施層面：約 10 萬個加速器、基於 SGLang 的引擎、W8A8 量化、混合精度 KV 快取，以及編碼–預填充–解碼分離式架構；相較先前的基準，回報的端到端吞吐量約為 3 倍。沒有新權重、沒有新評估、沒有新能力宣稱——只是通往同一個模型的更快路徑，而且每一項的價格都是 2.5 倍。

在百度的命名體系中，flash 是一個尺寸等級，而非速度層級，而其中的模型同時在做三件事。它是預覽版：百度的發布文章稱其為「後訓練階段的中間檢查點」，並表示該模型正朝正式發布持續改進。它是一個開關被焊死的推理模型——千帆的價目表只列出一個高努力等級，而建構於該端點上的公開前端也記錄了 enabled=false 與 effort="none" 都會被以 400 拒絕。而且它僅支援文字，對 2026 年的 flash 層級而言，這如今已是例外而非常態。

## 逐行比較

• 價格 — ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 每百萬個 token 輸入 $0.28 / 輸出 $1.13，相較於 GLM-5.3-FlashX 的 $0.37 / $1.25

• 快取輸入 — $0.028 對比 $0.075；快取儲存在 Z.ai 方面列為限時免費

• 速度 — ERNIE 完全未公布吞吐量數據，相較之下，廠商報告的峰值可達每秒 200 個 token

• 上下文 — 1,024,000 對比 1,048,576，實際上不相上下

• 最大輸出 — 921,600 對比約 131,072，視主機而定

• 輸入模態 — 僅文字對比文字、圖像、影片與檔案

• 推理控制 — 強制性，單一努力等級，相對於基礎模型自身的行為，維持不變地繼承

• 架構 — 總參數 280B／活躍參數 14B（已揭露），相較於總參數 320B／活躍參數 18B（已揭露）

• 權重 — 承諾以 Apache 2.0 授權卻未兌現，對比之下，基礎模型提供 MIT 授權的權重；FlashX 本身是託管層級，並沒有自己的權重

• 獨立分數 — FlashX 為「無對無」，其繼承了 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0.1 上的 28 分

其中兩行值得特別挑出來說。輸出上限方面，ERNIE 以七倍之差佔優，而在強制推理模型上，這項限制決定了一項長任務能否在一次呼叫中完成。模態那行則相反，而且是絕對的：ERNIE 看不到圖像。螢幕截圖轉程式碼的工作流程、影片摘要管線、文件版面擷取任務——這些在百度這邊無論出多少錢都無法使用，而在 Z.ai 這邊全都可以使用，價格為每百萬輸出 token 1.25 美元。

## 本文中唯一經過獨立測量的數字

{{1}}GLM-5.3-Flash{{/1}} 是 FlashX 所運行的模型，目前在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 5.0.1 版上得分 28；該分數是在 Z.ai 自家 API 上測得，實測輸出速度為每秒 46 個 token，按定價表計算，每百萬 token 的費用為 $0.15 與 $0.50。任何人若為此模型引用更高的數字，都是在引用該指數較早的修訂版；數字已經變動，而 28 就是它目前的水準。FlashX 之所以繼承該分數，是因為它繼承了權重——較高的價格買到的是延遲，而非智慧，而 Z.ai 從未作出相反的主張。

那一頁有個細節與速度宣傳相牴觸，值得特別指出。索引條目形容 GLM-5.3-Flash 每項任務明顯偏慢——每個索引任務 48.6 分鐘，相較中位數 14.6 分鐘——並回報首個答案 token 的時間為 96.53 秒。200 tok/s 的解碼速率並不能解決在答案第一個 token 出現前要等待一分半鐘的問題。FlashX 是吞吐量層級，它改善的就是吞吐量；如果你的工作負載卡在首 token 延遲，而不是總生成時間，那你付費換來的倍數可能根本碰不到你的瓶頸。

ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 沒有對應版本。百度的二十行表格——Terminal-Bench 4.0 為 46.5、DeepSWE v1.1 為 71.2、MCP-Atlas 為 84.6、BrowseComp 為 87.4、HLE 在無工具情況下為 46.4——是由廠商自行執行、採用廠商自行選擇的測試框架，而註腳也承認其中某些列需要一個工具呼叫另一家公司的模型來處理影像。這是宣稱，不是測量。若與一個繼承而來、獨立產出的 28 並列，兩者並不可比，而假裝並非如此，就會是這場對決所招致的錯誤。

## 真正站得住腳的成本比較

把兩個輸出費率並列來看，ERNIE 似乎便宜 10%：1.13 美元對上 1.25 美元。一旦把每個模型實際輸出的量納入考量，這個差距就會消失，甚至可能反轉。

FlashX 是固定能力、固定價格的模型。完成一項任務會依其輸出 token 以 $1.25 計費，而你可以從基礎模型在獨立測試工具上實測的行為來估算。ERNIE 的輸出速率由一個你無法關閉或縮短的推理過程決定。在答案開始之前，每一 token 的思考都按 $1.13 計費。沒有人公布 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 有多冗長，而這個缺口不是腳註——在兩張幾乎相同的價目表之間，冗長程度是最大的單一變動因素。

正確的說法比兩家廠商所希望的都更狹窄。ERNIE 在輸入與輸出上每 token 都更便宜，而在快取讀取上又更便宜，價格為 $0.028，相較之下是 $0.075。它每完成一項任務是否更便宜，取決於一個沒有人測量過的數字。FlashX 每 token 較貴，但其每項任務成本至少是可預測的，因為其底層行為已由第三方測量過。

FlashX 的付費版真正划算的地方，在於重複迴圈的情境。一個代理依序進行十次呼叫，就能把每次呼叫的延遲差距省下十倍；如果這個差距是兩、三秒，你就等於每項任務賺回半分鐘的實際耗時，而對互動式完成或有人在等草稿的情況來說，這樣的取捨通常是對的。它不划算的地方，則是在沒有人盯著的批次作業；而這也正是最適合 ERNIE 大得多的輸出上限的工作負載——前提是它能被信任會完成。

## 一把鑰匙，兩種截然不同的風險

OrcaRouter 提供 FlashX 旗下的開放模型 GLM-5.3-Flash，但不提供 FlashX 本身，也完全不提供任何 ERNIE 模型——超過 200 個模型的目錄中沒有百度的條目。這個區別值得說清楚，因為它改變了路由層在這裡的用途。如果你想獲得 GLM-5.3-Flash 的能力，又不想支付 2.5 倍輸送量溢價，它與其他所有項目使用同一把 OpenAI 相容金鑰，以供應商定價提供、不加價。如果你想評估 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview，你需要百度自家的存取權限，而明智的做法是把它放在生產路徑旁邊運行，而不是放進生產路徑裡：自動容錯移轉會把因推理參數而觸發的 400，或在季度中途、在你使用時發生變動的預覽版，轉成一個經路由的請求，而不是一次服務中斷。

這兩種安排都不會讓未經評測的模型變成已評測。它只是讓比較的成本低到足以實際執行，而對於兩個沒有任何獨立測試框架評分過的端點，這已是路由器所能誠實提供的最多保證。

## 決策真正轉折之處

三個問題就能定案，而它們之中沒有一個是「哪個比較快」。

任務是否涉及圖片、影片或 PDF？若是，比較還沒開始就結束了。ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 是文字輸入、文字輸出，再大的價格優勢也無法替代它不具備的模態。GLM-5.3-FlashX 三種都能處理，它所運行的較便宜基礎模型也一樣。

任務是否想要一個非常長的答案？如果是，七比一的輸出上限就大幅有利於 ERNIE——前提是你能接受一個預覽版，而它表明的立場是後訓練尚未完成。300,000 個 token 的生成不是 FlashX 會在單一請求中做的事，而分段處理會以費率卡未顯示的方式改變成本計算。

工作負載是否具互動性？若有人在等待，就購買吞吐量方案，並接受你是在為服務堆疊支付 2.5 倍費用，而不是為模型付費。若沒有任何東西在等待，額外費用買不到任何可衡量的東西，而價格為 $0.15 和 $0.50 的基礎模型，才是取得相同權重更便宜的方式。

令人不安的結論是：這裡較貴的模型，是行為可預測的那個；較便宜的模型，則是其行為在百度以外無人發表過的那個。這不是付溢價的理由，而是先量測替代方案、再在其上建構的理由——也是要留意，「flash」並沒有告訴你有關任一模型的任何規格表沒說的事。

Kimi.content:
# Moonshot (Kimi)

Moonshot AI provides an OpenAI-compatible API for its Kimi models — the Kimi K3 and K2 thinking models and the Moonshot v1 generation models. The Moonshot provider extends the OpenAI provider, so all of its options are supported.

## Setup

- Get an API key from the Kimi (Moonshot) platform.
- Set theMOONSHOT_API_KEY environment variable or specify apiKey in your config.

Kimi K3 requires a successful account top-up of at least $1; see the access requirements.
providers:
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k3

Bothmoonshot:<model> and moonshot:chat:<model> resolve to the chat completions endpoint. If you omit the model, the provider defaults to kimi-k3.

## Available Models

Moonshot's lineup rotates over time — call the list models API (GET https://api.moonshot.ai/v1/models) for the live set. As of writing:

- Kimi K3 — flagship thinking model, 1M context:kimi-k3 (released July 2026). Always-on reasoning, native image and video understanding, and a top-level reasoning_effort control (see below).
- Kimi K2 — thinking models, 256k context:kimi-k2.6, kimi-k2.5, kimi-k2.7-code, kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed. These reason before answering and emit a separate reasoning stream (see below).
- Moonshot v1 — legacy generation models:moonshot-v1-8k, moonshot-v1-32k, moonshot-v1-128k (context-length variants) and the vision variants moonshot-v1-8k-vision-preview / moonshot-v1-32k-vision-preview / moonshot-v1-128k-vision-preview; existing accounts may also see the auto-router moonshot-v1-auto in the list-models API. The moonshot-v1 series and kimi-k2.5 are closed to newly registered users and sunset platform-wide on August 31, 2026.

The olderkimi-k2-0711-preview, kimi-k2-0905-preview, kimi-k2-turbo-preview, kimi-k2-thinking, kimi-k2-thinking-turbo, and kimi-latest ids were discontinued in 2026 — Moonshot recommends migrating to kimi-k3.

## Configuration
providers:
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k3 # flagship thinking model — leave sampling params unset
  - id: moonshot:moonshot-v1-8k # legacy generation model — accepts arbitrary sampling
    config:
      temperature: 0.2
      max_tokens: 1024

### Configuration Options

The provider accepts every option the OpenAI provider supports. Commonly used:

- temperature, max_tokens, top_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty
- stream
- response_format (JSON mode), tools / tool_choice (function calling)
- showThinking — set to false to drop a thinking model's reasoning from the graded output (default true)
- cost, inputCost, outputCost, cacheReadCost — Moonshot ships no built-in price table, so set these to track cost. Every override is in USD per token. Moonshot's official pricing page publishes rates in USD per 1 million tokens, so divide each published rate by 1,000,000 before configuring it. inputCost/outputCost take precedence over the flat cost; cacheReadCost prices cached prompt tokens.

For example, these illustrative per-million rates convert to per-token overrides. Check the official pricing page for the current rates for your model before using them.
providers:
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k3
    config:
      inputCost: 0.000003 # $3.00 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000
      cacheReadCost: 0.0000003 # $0.30 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000
      outputCost: 0.000015 # $15.00 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k2.6
    config:
      inputCost: 0.00000095 # $0.95 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000
      cacheReadCost: 0.00000016 # $0.16 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000
      outputCost: 0.000004 # $4.00 per 1M tokens divided by 1,000,000

Any other parameter supported by the OpenAI provider is forwarded as-is.

## Kimi thinking models

Thekimi-k3 and kimi-k2.x models are reasoning models and behave differently from the moonshot-v1 family:

- Fixed sampling parameters. Kimi pinstemperature (1.0 with thinking on), top_p, n, and the penalties to fixed values and returns a 400 ("invalid temperature: only 1 is allowed for this model") for any other value. The provider therefore does not send promptfoo's default temperature/max_tokens for kimi-* models — leave them unset (recommended) or set temperature: 1. The moonshot-v1 models accept arbitrary sampling values.
- Reasoning output. Kimi returns a separatereasoning_content stream that promptfoo surfaces with a Thinking: … prefix. Set showThinking: false when you assert on structured output (for example is-json) so the reasoning doesn't contaminate the parsed result.
- Token budget. Reasoning tokens count against the output budget. When you leave the token limit unset the provider lets Moonshot apply its server default (32k for K2.x, 131k for K3); if you set one, leave generous headroom for the answer. Moonshot's canonical field ismax_completion_tokens (max_tokens is a deprecated alias) — the provider sends max_completion_tokens for kimi-* models whichever of the two you configure.
- Controlling thinking. The two generations use different, mutually exclusive controls:
- kimi-k3 is always thinking and accepts a top-level reasoning_effort field, which the provider forwards from config.reasoning_effort. Supported values are low, high, and max (the default). Do not send the K2.x thinking parameter to K3 — the API rejects it.
- kimi-k2.6 and kimi-k2.5 support thinking: { type: disabled } (pass it via config.passthrough); kimi-k2.7-code is always thinking. The thinking parameter is K2.x-only.
- Settingconfig.reasoning_effort on a non-K3 model is a configuration error and the provider fails fast with a clear message instead of sending it.

providers:
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k3
    config:
      showThinking: false
      reasoning_effort: max # optional: low, high, or max (default)
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k2.6
    config:
      passthrough:
        thinking: { type: disabled } # K2.x only: turn reasoning off

See the Kimi K3 quickstart and Using Thinking Models for the full behavior matrix.

## Vision

The vision models (moonshot-v1-*-vision-preview) and the multimodal Kimi models (kimi-k3, kimi-k2.5, kimi-k2.6, kimi-k2.7-code, kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed) accept base64-encoded image input using the standard OpenAI image_url content format. Moonshot does not accept remote image URLs — embed images as data: URIs or reference files uploaded to the Kimi platform as ms://<file-id>. Video input is supported by kimi-k3, kimi-k2.6, kimi-k2.7-code, and kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed, referenced the same way after uploading via the files API. See Use the Kimi Vision Model.

## Example Usage
providers:
  - id: moonshot:kimi-k3
  - id: openai:gpt-4o-mini

prompts:
  - 'Summarize the following in one sentence: {{text}}'

tests:
  - vars:
      text: 'Promptfoo is an open-source tool for testing and evaluating LLM apps.'

A runnable comparison lives in examples/provider-moonshot.

## API Details

- Base URL:https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 (global). China-mainland keys use https://api.moonshot.cn/v1 — point at it with apiBaseUrl, since the global and China platforms issue region-locked keys.
- OpenAI-compatible chat completions API.
- Full API documentation.

## See Also

- OpenAI Provider — compatible configuration options
- Kimi model list and pricing

xAI.content:
# 不用派活，它自己找活：马斯克的新同事上线了

2026-11-13 08:15:37 来源: 互联网早读课 北京 举报

0

分享至

早读课推荐

这篇来自机器之心。Grok Bot 1.0 今天发布，最核心的变化不是能力，是归属：Bot 从「只认一个主人」变成全组共用，被拉进 Slack、Teams 和视频会议。文末把豆包、飞书、千问摆在一起比，才看出这场「AI 同事」竞赛真正的分水岭在哪。

感觉 xAI 改成 SpaceX Super Intelligence 之后，马斯克在 AI 上很久没有过什么大动静了。

就在刚刚，Grok Bot 1.0 版本正式发布了。

「机器人可以共享，并且比以往任何时候都更具协作性和能力。」

按照 SpaceX Super Intelligence 的说法，新版的 Grok Bot 可以被整个团队共享，能被拉进 Slack、Microsoft Teams 和视频会议，会在讨论里看出谁在说什么、哪件事还没人接，然后主动举手说「这个我来」。

换句话说，它会像一个真正的同事那样，和你一起开会、一起工作。

虽然类同事的合作智能体早已经不是什么新鲜事，但从宣传视频里来看，Grok Bot 1.0 延续了 Grok 自然语音沟通的传统优势，高效自然的写作方式，特别像一个真人。似乎还可以创建和调用其他的智能体 Bot，无缝协作。而且，Grok Bot 的形象看上去非常可爱。

还有，从视频里看，马斯克要卖耳机了？

01 三个月，从内部原型到「转正」

Grok Bot 第一次露面，是在三个月前。

今年 8 月 11 日，xAI 首次推出 Grok Bot beta 版，定位是「可以交付真实工作的 AI 队友」。

它最初是一个内部原型，后来在公司里火了起来，各个团队用它处理销售、市场活动、行政运营、修 bug 等工作。官方博客里描述过几个内部场景，销售 Bot 会把通话记录整理进 CRM 并起草跟进邮件，运营 Bot 会给新员工安排工位、处理 Gmail 里收到的发票，工程 Bot 能在产品界面里复现 bug、提交工单，再把修复任务交给专门负责调试的 Bot。

当时 Grok Bot 最大的卖点，是每个 Bot 都有一台自己的云端电脑。

这意味着它能像人一样登录各种工具、在网页和应用之间来回切换，就算某个平台没有干净的 API 或 MCP 接口，它也能直接在界面上把活干完。你合上电脑去吃饭，它也能继续工作。

beta 版首批开放给 SuperGrok 系列订阅用户，以及 Cursor Pro、Ultra、Teams 等付费用户。不过，beta 版的 Bot 本质上还是「个人助理」，它服务的是创建它的那个人。

02 Grok Bot 1.0 更新了什么？

Grok Bot 1.0 的升级有三个关键词，多人协作、主动出击、能力更强。我们逐一拆开来看。

多人协作：一个 Bot，全组共用

这次最核心的变化，是 Team Bots。

过去一个 Bot 只认一个主人，现在团队里的每个人都可以和同一个 Bot 协作。共享方式也更灵活，可以只分享给特定的人或小组，也可以直接把它拉进 Slack 或 Microsoft Teams。

更有意思的是它的学习方式。随着和不同的人打交道，Bot 会逐渐了解团队在做什么、每个人负责什么、各自有什么偏好，对每个人都越来越有用。

在多人对话里，Bot 能跟上好几个人之间的讨论，搞清楚谁参与了、各自在说什么，然后在合适的时候补充信息，或者主动提出接手某项工作。

此外，Bot 还能参加视频会议。它通过会议聊天框参与讨论，把之前对话里的相关信息带进来，同时记下会上做出的决定。

主动出击：不用派活，自己找活

如果说共享解决的是「谁能用」，那么主动性解决的就是「什么时候用」。

1.0 的 Bot 可以持续盯着进行中的项目，发现哪里需要处理，再根据自己对团队目标、流程和优先级的理解，提出下一步建议。

举个产品发布的例子。Bot 看到某个截止日期快到了，就会提前把团队需要的材料准备好。它也会追踪没收尾的任务，和其他 Bot 协调分工，遇到需要人来判断的决策，再把相关的人拉进来。

我们知道，beta 版的 Grok Bot 是「把工作交给 AI 队友」的一种方式，而到了 1.0，这些队友已经能理解团队在做的事和做事的人，可以像其他同事一样主动做出贡献。

越用越懂：一个人教会，全组受益

Team Bot 会在工作中持续积累对团队的理解。它会记住每个人的习惯和已经做过的决定，也会吸收不同成员的专业经验。

这里有一个很实用的设计。当某个人教会 Bot 一种更好的做事方法，这个改进会惠及所有使用它的人。 Bot 自己也会根据从团队里学到的东西，反过来建议调整自己的工作方式。

放进公共频道的 AI，安全自然是绕不开的问题。为此，xAI 加了几道防护：

尊重权限：Bot 遵守每个人各自的访问权限

敏感操作先问：执行敏感操作前会先征求同意

公开前把关：在公开频道分享信息前，会判断这条信息适不适合公开

xAI 的意思是，有了这些防护，团队才敢把更多责任交给 Bot，同时仍然掌握它能看什么、能做什么。

能力更强：更快、更稳、更省

除了协作方式的变化，Bot 本身的能力也有一轮升级。相比 beta 版，主要改进包括：

浏览器操作更稳：浏览网站更可靠，登录流程更顺畅，任务中断更少

文档和演示更好：写出的文档、做出的 PPT 质量更高，还能生成可交互的 Pages，团队可以一起编辑，也可以让 Bot 持续更新

跨应用能力更强：与 Gmail、Google Calendar、GitHub 等工具的连接得到改进，能直接完成更多工作

审批更聪明：Bot 更清楚哪些操作你已经授权过、哪些还需要再问，少打扰，同时保护敏感信息

新增设置与数据分析：管理员可以管理 Team Bot 掌握的知识，也能看到团队是怎么使用它的

xAI 还提到，新版本完成任务所需的资源更少，效率更高。

03 从「工具」变成「同事」，早已不是新鲜事

早期的 AI 产品围绕个人效率展开，一个人、一个对话框、一次任务。现在，越来越多的厂商开始把目光投向团队，AI 要面对的是多个人、多个工具、持续运转的项目。

把 AI 拉进工作群当同事，国内的协同办公平台早就在做了。

比如，「豆包工作伙伴」是类似的思路，定位是智能体搭建与协作平台。团队使用的工作伙伴可以直接添加到工作群里，共享群内上下文，供群里所有成员共同使用；它会在使用者已有的权限范围内，连通消息、文档、会议、任务和业务系统，主动帮人推进工作。

飞书「工作小队」可以实现多个工作伙伴组成一支小队，其中一个担任队长，负责接收任务、拆解工作、调度成员、交付成果。协作方式也被做成了模板，有路由、专家会诊、圆桌讨论、接力、生产评审、红蓝对抗等 8 种。Grok Bot 1.0 里「一个 Bot 和另一个 Bot 配合」的场景，在这里已经被产品化成了一套标准流程。

千问办公今年 8 月正式上线，深度接入钉钉生态，在钉钉工作台里就能直接唤起。每个空间配一位数字员工小 Q，关联钉钉群聊、文档、表格等作为共同上下文，团队成员直接在 IM 里给它交办任务。Grok Bot 与之如出一辙。

几家产品的思路高度相似。共享给团队、接入真实的工作软件、长期记忆、权限对齐、主动推进任务，这几乎已经成了「AI 同事」类产品的标配清单。

飞书和钉钉本身就是团队工作地方，聊天记录、文档、审批流都长在同一个平台上。Grok Bot 没有自己的办公平台，只能带着一台云端电脑，去 Slack、Teams 和视频会议里「上门打工」。好处是不挑平台，哪里有活去哪里；代价是对团队上下文的掌握，要靠一次次对话慢慢积累。

Grok Bot 1.0 即日起上线，用户可以为自己创建 Bot，也可以分享给团队，或者拉进 Slack、Microsoft Teams 和视频会议。目前桌面端提供 macOS 版本下载。

具体权限上，Team Bots 面向 Team 和 Enterprise 套餐开放；会议功能面向 Team、Enterprise 和 Ultra 套餐开放，企业版管理员需要在设置中手动开启。

## واجهة Grok 4.3 API {#grok-4-3-api}

# transformers 5.23.0 Release v5.23.0

one hour ago

# Release v5.23.0

## New Model additions

### Inkling2

Inkling 2 Small is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs, and it is intended for use in English and other languages and across multiple coding languages. Its language backbone has 48 mixture-of-experts decoder layers, each routing tokens to 8 of 384 experts, for 594B total and 17B active parameters. It keeps the Inkling decoder (learned relative attention, short causal convolutions, mixture-of-experts layers) and adds block attention residuals, gated attention with a learned sink, and dynamic key/value convolutions. Images are encoded by a Perception Encoder-based vision transformer and projected into the language model embeddings, one embedding per 40x40 pixel patch.

### JEV

JEV is a decision head that scores single-token labels with a linear layer at the last token of the prompt, soft-capped like the logits of a language model head.JevForDecision is the model of the checkpoint and its head, and it reads the head files shipped next to the weights (head.safetensors and judge_config.json for JEV). The same head is also used by GEV and reads the 255 answer codes of pplx-decider and d3, and it can be run through the experimental decision pipeline or directly with decide.

Note: JEV and the decision pipeline are currently experimental. Their APIs, configuration, and behavior may change as development continues. They should be used with caution in production environments.

### LFM3

LFM3 is the third generation of Liquid Foundation Models from Liquid AI. Like LFM2, it is a hybrid architecture that combines gated short convolutions with grouped-query attention, with the attention layers split between full-attention and sliding-window layers. The attention layers apply RMSNorm to the query and key heads and gate their output with a per-head sigmoid. Every layer applies a sandwich norm to the operator and feed-forward outputs before the residual addition.

### Dots 3 Note Preview

Dots 3 Note Preview is a mixture-of-experts causal language model that accepts native text, image, video, and audio inputs. It uses a shared vision encoder for images and videos and a Whisper-style audio encoder, and both encoders project their outputs into the language model's hidden space before autoregressive text generation. BF16 and FP8 inference are supported.

### LFM3-VL

LFM3-VL is a vision-language model family from Liquid AI, built on the LFM3 language model. It takes images and videos at their native resolution together with text. It combines a hybrid vision encoder (a linear patchifier, gated depthwise 2D convolution layers, and bidirectional grouped-query attention layers with 2D rotary embeddings) with a projector and an LFM3 language model. The projector merges each 2x2 block of patch features into one language token through a layer norm and a two-layer MLP.

### IQuestCoder

IQuest-Coder-V1 is a family of code language models developed by IQuest Lab, available in 7B, 14B and 40B sizes with base, instruct and thinking variants. Its architecture is the same as Llama, so the Transformers auto classes load it with LlamaModel and LlamaForCausalLM, and only IQuestCoderConfig is specific to IQuestCoder. The loopedIQuest-Coder-V1-*-Loop-* checkpoints use a different architecture and aren't supported.

### InternLM3

InternLM3 is an 8B instruction-tuned language model developed by Shanghai AI Laboratory (checkpoint: internlm/internlm3-8b-instruct). Its architecture is the same as Llama, so the auto classes load it with the Llama implementation (LlamaModel and LlamaForCausalLM), and only InternLM3Config is specific to InternLM3. The config names the attention biasesqkv_bias and the output projection and MLP biases bias. InternLM3Config loads these as attention_bias and mlp_bias and requires them to be equal, as they are in the released checkpoints.

## Breaking changes

- 🚨 Remove theep_router expert-parallel style (#49615) by @IlyasMoutawwakil

- 🚨 Run MXFP4 GPT-OSS experts throughep_dispatch_experts (#49613) by @IlyasMoutawwakil

- 🚨deepgemm_megamoe EP implementation for DeepGEMM Mega MoE (#49606) by @IlyasMoutawwakil

- 🚨 Slim down[audio] to torchaudio + soundfile + soxr (drop librosa and phonemizer) (#50610) by @eustlb

- 🚨 Deprecate Wav2Vec2ProcessorWithLM and pyctcdecode/kenlm LM decoding (#50408) by @eustlb
- 🚨 Exporters:ExportedModel, Hub save/load, one backend registry (#50029) by @IlyasMoutawwakil

- 🚨 Move processing defaults to class (#49089) by @guarin
- 🚨 [kernels] Bump version (#50307) by @vasqu

- 🚨 Finally drop rope deltas from ModelOutput! (#50153) by @zucchini-nlp
- 🚨 Safe-ize pi0 graphs (#50160) by @molbap
- 🚨 [serve][breaking] update attn for mac users (#49730) by @SunMarc
- 🚨 build and expand once the tp/ep_plan/fsdp_plan (#49527) by @3outeille

## Exporters: export, share and run any model on its backend (#50029, #50032, #50309, #50311)

## exporters.mp4

Every export now returns anExportedModel. You call it like the original model (same kwargs, same output class), push it to the Hub, and load it back on the backend's own runtime. The same API covers Dynamo, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch.

from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer
from transformers.exporters import ExportedModel, OnnxConfig, OnnxExporter

model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("google/embeddinggemma-2")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("google/embeddinggemma-2")
inputs = tokenizer(["Exporters are here!"], return_tensors="pt")

exported = OnnxExporter().export(model, inputs, OnnxConfig(dynamic=True, ort_fusions="cuda"))
exported.push_to_hub("my-org/embeddinggemma-2-onnx")

exported_model = ExportedModel.from_pretrained("my-org/embeddinggemma-2-onnx", device="cuda")
outputs = exported_model(**inputs)  # same output class as model(**inputs)
- Fused for the runtime:OnnxConfig(ort_fusions="cpu" | "cuda" | "webgpu" | "dml") rewrites the graph into ONNX Runtime's fused transformer ops at export time: attention, GroupQueryAttention over the KV cache, rotary, norms and MoE. OpenVINO exports now hit OpenVINO's fused CPU kernels for attention, RoPE, MoE experts and compressed int8/int4 weights, which makes decode 2.4–3.9× faster than before.

- Faster thantorch.compile: on EmbeddingGemma2 (8 × 128 tokens), ONNX Runtime with the TensorRT EP is 7.6× faster than eager PyTorch and 1.4× faster than torch.compile on an A100. OpenVINO is 4.1× faster than eager and 2.2× faster than torch.compile on a Xeon Platinum 8570 (4.9× and 2.6× with int8 weights).

- Shareable: an export saves and loads like a model, optionally in asubfolder of the model repo. Its export.json records the config, input shapes, package versions and I/O names. Quantized exports (PT2E, NNCF, ONNX Runtime) save and run the same way.

🚨export() returns an ExportedModel, and an ONNX program is an onnx_ir.Model. OnnxConfig's and OpenVINOConfig's output_path options are gone in favour of save_pretrained. Custom backends register with register_backend.

## Vision

This release fixes a range of vision-model bugs: classification pipelines now respectproblem_type, and several models get corrected behavior (Step3.7 RoPE axis order, MiniMax-M3-VL packed attention isolation, Qwen VL positions with reused caches, PaddleOCR-VL interpolation alignment, Kosmos2 SDPA masking, and Emu3 float image handling). Chunked prefill now keeps image inputs on the

This release improves distributed training and inference. Expert parallelism gains a selectableep_implementation (all-reduce for CUDA-graph-friendly inference, all-to-all for training). The Trainer now reduces FSDP/HSDP gradients only on the last micro-batch, and the token-count normalization is fixed to use true division. Tensor-parallel fixes cover attention sinks (including Beam attention) and tied-weight comparisons on TPU

## Parallelization

This release improves distributed training and inference. Expert parallelism gains a selectableep_implementation (all-reduce for CUDA-graph-friendly inference, all-to-all for training). The Trainer now reduces FSDP/HSDP gradients only on the last micro-batch, and the token-count normalization is fixed to use true division. Tensor-parallel fixes cover attention sinks (including Beam attention) and tied-weight comparisons on TPU

cross_cutting.content:
## LLMs

本章节收录主流大语言模型。先是 2024–2026 年最具影响力的旗舰、开源与国产模型，随后保留早期经典开源 LLM 供学习参考。

### 2024–2026 主流大模型

时间与版本截至 2026 年 8 月，模型迭代极快，请以官方渠道为准。

#### 国外闭源旗舰模型

模型 | 开发方 | 链接 | 中文简介（关键能力与发布时间） 
---|---|---|---
GPT-5.6（Luna / Terra / Sol） | OpenAI | openai.com | 2026 年 7 月 9 日发布的三档模型家族（由弱到强 Luna / Terra / Sol），面向企业工作、编码、科研与网络安全；Sol 为最强档，8 月 21 日起 API 降价 20%+。 
GPT-5 | OpenAI | openai.com | 2025 年 8 月发布，OpenAI 新一代旗舰，统一推理与对话（自动调度"思考"模式），取代 GPT-4o/o3 成为 ChatGPT 默认模型。 
o3 / o4-mini | OpenAI | openai.com | 2025 年 4 月发布的 o 系列推理模型，"先思考后回答"，o4-mini 主打高性价比快速推理。 
GPT-4.1 | OpenAI | openai.com | 2025 年 4 月发布，专精编码，100 万 token 长上下文，指令遵循强。 
Claude 5 家族（Fable 5 / Opus 5 / Sonnet 5） | Anthropic | platform.claude.com | 2026 年 6–7 月发布的第 5 代：Fable 5（6 月 9 日，Mythos 级旗舰，$10/$50 每百万 token）、Sonnet 5（6 月 30 日，$2/$10）、Opus 5（7 月 24 日，$5/$25，接近 Fable 5 智能但价格减半）；三者均 1M 上下文、128K 输出、自适应思考。 
Claude Opus 4.5 | Anthropic | anthropic.com | 2025 年 11 月发布，Anthropic 最强模型，编码与智能体能力顶尖。 
Claude Sonnet 4.5 | Anthropic | anthropic.com | 2025 年 9 月发布，平衡性能与成本，长程智能体任务表现优异。 
Claude 4（Opus 4 / Sonnet 4） | Anthropic | anthropic.com | 2025 年 5 月发布的第 4 代，Opus 4 号称"世界最佳编码模型"。 
Gemini 3.x（3.7 Flash / 3.5 Flash / 3.1 Pro） | Google DeepMind | changelog | 2026 年迭代：3.5 Flash（5 月 GA）、3.6 Flash（7 月）、3.7 Flash（8 月 13 日 GA，「最智能的编码 / Agent 主力模型」）；3.1 Pro 仍为预览。另有 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 视频生成模型（8 月 GA）。 
Gemini 3 Pro | Google DeepMind | blog.google | 2025 年 11 月发布，Google 最强多模态旗舰，"推理优先"，含 Deep Think 模式。 
Gemini 2.5 Pro / Flash | Google DeepMind | developers.googleblog.com | "思考型"系列，Pro 主打高智能、Flash 主打低延迟低成本。 
Grok 4 | xAI | x.ai | 2025 年 7 月发布，256K 上下文，原生工具调用（代码、联网与 X 搜索）。 

#### 国外开源 / 开放权重模型

模型 | 开发方 | 链接 | 中文简介（关键能力与发布时间） 
---|---|---|---
Llama 4（Scout / Maverick） | Meta | ai.meta.com | 2025 年 4 月发布，原生多模态 MoE，Scout 上下文达 10M，Maverick 多模态超 GPT-4o。 
Llama 3.3 70B | Meta | llama.com | 2024 年 12 月发布，70B 性能对标 3.1 的 405B，推理成本大幅降低。 
Mistral Large 3 | Mistral AI | mistral.ai | 2025 年 12 月发布，稀疏 MoE，41B 激活 / 675B 总参，开放权重前沿模型。 
Gemma 3 | ai.google.dev | Google 开源小模型系列，基于 Gemini 技术，可单卡运行、多模态。 

#### 国产大模型

模型 | 开发方 | 链接 | 中文简介（关键能力与发布时间） 
---|---|---|---
DeepSeek-V4（Pro / Flash） | 深度求索 | HuggingFace ・生态指南 | 2026 年 4 月预览、8 月 GA。Pro 1.6T/49B 激活、Flash 284B/13B 激活，DSA 稀疏注意力，1M 上下文，MIT 开放权重，支持 low/high/max 推理强度，Agent 与编码能力比肩顶级闭源模型。 
DeepSeek-V3.2 / V3.2-Speciale | 深度求索 | 论文 | 2025 年 12 月发布，引入 DSA 稀疏注意力，正式版比肩 GPT-5；Speciale 在 IMO / IOI / ICPC 2025 达金牌水平。 
DeepSeek-V3.1 / V3.1-Terminus | 深度求索 | HuggingFace | 2025 年 8–9 月，混合推理架构（思考 / 非思考双模式），面向 Agent 工具调用优化。 
DeepSeek-V3 | 深度求索 | GitHub | 2024 年 12 月发布，671B/37B 激活 MoE，以极高性价比对标 GPT-4 级别。 
DeepSeek-R1 | 深度求索 | GitHub | 2025 年 1 月发布的开源推理模型，比肩 o1，掀起全球开源推理浪潮；5 月 R1-0528 升级版。 
DeepSeekMath-V2 / OCR-2 | 深度求索 | Math-V2 ・OCR-2 | 专项模型：Math-V2（2025-11）自我可验证数学推理达 IMO 金牌；OCR-2（2026-01）Visual Causal Flow 文档理解。 
Qwen3（通义千问 3） | 阿里巴巴 | GitHub | 2025 年 4 月发布，Apache 2.0 开源，0.6B–235B 多规格，首推混合推理，支持 119 种语言与 MCP。 
GLM-4.6 / GLM-4.5 | 智谱 AI | HuggingFace | GLM-4.5（2025 年 7 月）355B/32B MoE，MIT 协议开源，面向智能体；GLM-4.6 进一步升级。 
Kimi K3 | 月之暗面 | GitHub ・HuggingFace | 2026 年 7 月开放权重（Kimi K3 License）：2.8T 参数原生多模态 Agent 模型，KDA + AttnRes 新架构，896 专家激活 16 个，1M 上下文，主打长程编码与端到端知识工作；配套开源 RL 环境平台 AgentENV。 
Kimi K2 / K2 Thinking | 月之暗面 | GitHub | K2（2025 年 7 月）1T/32B MoE 开源；K2 Thinking（11 月）多项基准超 GPT-5、Sonnet 4.5。 
MiniMax M2 | MiniMax | GitHub | 2025 年 10 月发布的开源大模型，主打高效推理与智能体能力。 
ERNIE 4.5 / 文心一言 | 百度 | yiyan.baidu.com | 2025 年 3 月发布，MoE 架构最高 424B/47B；配套 ERNIE X1 深度推理模型。 
混元（Hunyuan / T1） | 腾讯 | hunyuan.tencent.com | 腾讯自研大模型家族，T1 推理模型开放使用，覆盖文本与多模态。 
豆包（Doubao） | 字节跳动 | doubao.com | 字节 C 端 AI 应用，月活领先，背后为字节自研大模型矩阵。 

#### 评测榜单与资源

资源 | 链接 | 中文简介 
---|---|---
LMArena（原 Chatbot Arena） | lmarena.ai | 众包匿名对战 + Elo 评分的权威 LLM 排行榜，业界最受认可的横向对比之一。 
Open LLM Leaderboard | HuggingFace | 基于标准化基准的开源模型自动评测榜单，适合硬指标对比。 
SuperCLUE | superclueai.com | 中文通用大模型综合性测评基准，中文场景的主流权威榜单。 
Artificial Analysis | artificialanalysis.ai | 第三方独立评测，汇总智能指数、速度、价格等维度，便于按性价比选型。 
中文大模型能力评测榜单 | chinese-llm-benchmark | 持续更新的中文大模型能力评测，覆盖国内外主流闭源与开源模型，含客观题与主观题多维度打分，适合中文场景选型参考。 
Models.dev | models.dev / GitHub | SST 团队开源的 AI 模型数据库，收录各家模型的上下文窗口、输出上限、价格、能力（推理/工具调用/结构化输出）与开闭源信息；提供免费 JSON API（models.dev/api.json），是 opencode 等开源项目的模型数据源，数据以 TOML 文件社区共建。 

### 早期经典开源 LLM（历史存档）

以下为 2023 年前后的开源模型，多数已被新版取代，保留供学习与参考。

### 大模型

# Meta launches Muse Ember, its smallest and cheapest model

November 13, 2026

A
AI at Meta
Meta introduced Muse Ember on November 9, its smallest and most efficient model, aimed at the work agents repeat all day: tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction and long-document parsing. It is available now on the Meta Model API at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens.

Meta pitches it on intelligence per dollar. It claims Ember matches Claude Haiku 5.5's best Artificial Analysis score at about a third of the cost and beats every setting of GPT-6 Luna, and that no model on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard scores higher for less per task. In Meta's own comparison at maximum reasoning, Ember leads Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna on AutomationBench (37.8 vs. 13.9 and 20.2), Agents' Last Exam (61.6) and Terminal-Bench 4.0 (40.9), while trailing Haiku on FrontierCode 2.0. Google has launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, an AI model built for speed and efficiency in everyday workflows, now available in the Gemini app and powering Google Search globally.

## Gemini 4 Hydrogen officially released

Google announced Gemini 4 Hydrogen in a blog post, describing it as the “daily driver” for agentic workflows. The model rolls out today in the Gemini app and powers Google Search for all users worldwide. It is also live in Google AI Studio and the Antigravity service for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

Embedding Hydrogen across these platforms lets users tap into advanced language and multimodal capabilities without additional installations, while extending the reach to developers and enterprise customers.

## Performance advantage over rivals

Internal benchmarks show Gemini 4 Hydrogen leading competitor models on agentic coding and knowledge tasks, outpacing OpenAI’s GPT 6.1 Terra and Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 5.5. The model also claims top marks in multimodal understanding of images and video.

In science, math, computer‑use and Terminal‑Bench 4.1 tests, Hydrogen trails Anthropic and OpenAI by a narrow margin that Google describes as “small.”

## Speed gains and reliability

Google states Gemini 4 Hydrogen completes tasks 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash at its default setting. In partner tests involving complex graphs, SQL queries and data‑heavy workloads, the model delivered up to 2.8 times faster performance.

### Reduced hallucinations

Hydrogen reportedly generates more than five times fewer fabricated claims than its predecessor. When handling token‑intensive queries, it consumes up to 23 % fewer tokens, lowering cost and improving answer accuracy.

## Impact on Search and enterprise tools

Google Search benefits from Hydrogen with better query understanding, richer visual responses and a broader set of relevant links. Within the Gemini app, the model enhances research, writing, email handling and document creation.

Developers can access Hydrogen via the Gemini API, Android Studio and Google AI Studio across all subscription tiers. Enterprises may deploy it through the API or select it in Gemini Enterprise, and it will soon appear in Google Sheets for Pro and Ultra users.

## Key specifications

Metric | Improvement 
---|---
Speed vs Gemini 3.8 Flash | 2.5× faster (default) 
Hallucination reduction | >5× fewer fabricated claims 
Graph/SQL speed and token use | Up to 2.8× faster, 23% fewer tokens 

💡

## TechTimes Perspective

TechTimes believes Gemini 4 Hydrogen represents a strategic move by Google to deliver a fast, reliable AI experience for both consumers and businesses. By embedding the model in Search, Sheets and other core services, the company lowers the barrier for Vietnamese users to adopt cutting‑edge AI without high subscription fees. The real test will be how quickly Google extends the free tier to broader audiences, as the model’s speed and reduced hallucinations could reshape expectations for everyday AI assistants in the region.

cross_cutting.content:
# How Kuber Sharma, Senior Director of PMM at UiPath, built a team of AI agents to run product launches

I'll start with a confession: AI didn't come naturally to me.

I've been in product marketing long enough to know when something fits and when it doesn't. PMM fit me immediately. It felt like a calling. I left for product management for four years, chasing better pay, and came back because I didn't enjoy it. Product marketing is where I belong.

But agentic AI? That took a long time for me to adopt.

You’ve probably noticed that AI is reshaping who does what across the industry. Software developers are being squeezed by AI, so they're moving toward product management, and PMs are eyeing marketing in response. PMMs are getting it from both sides; technical folks with AI workflows are moving in, while demand gen and field marketing do things many of us can’t.

So, you've got two choices: you fear AI, or you embrace it. I chose to embrace it, but not without a few painful lessons along the way. I’m going to share those lessons in this article. Here’s what we’ll cover:

- Why it’s time to stop treating AI as a writing tool and start treating it as an operating system
- The four agents my team built to run product launches
- What went wrong with our first brief, and the rule that fixed it
- Our results, including the hours we got back
- Three steps to start building AI workflows of your own

## Rethinking AI

Most people start using AI as a content generator. I'm dyslexic and have never spelled anything correctly in my life. Finding a tool that helped me write was life-changing. But using AI to write content is just scratching the surface.

Think of it this way. I drive an 850-horsepower electric car. However, I live in North Seattle, where I almost never get above 25 miles per hour. We timed the trip from my house to downtown: 30 minutes by bike and 25 minutes in the car. That's how I used to feel about AI. I had all that power, and I was getting around at about the same speed as before.

The shift happens when you stop thinking about AI as a tool and start treating it as an operating system.

For expert insights like this, in full, every Friday, sign up for Pro+ membership.

You'll also get access to 30+ certifications, a complimentary Summit ticket every year, and 130+ product marketing templates.

还等什么呢？

## Five levels of AI maturity

As a PMM, I love frameworks, so I built one around AI adoption. It shows five levels of AI maturity, running from not started, through experimenting, operational, and integrated, up to agentic. I took it to my team, and we placed ourselves at Level 1 (experimenting) and made Level 3 (integrated) our north star.

The framework gave us a map of where we stood. It also gave us a way to track each agent's success, attach rate, and impact over time.

## Why we started with launches

Ask most PMMs where to start with AI, and you’ll hear the same two answers: competitive intel and sales enablement. They’re sensible picks, but when my team and I sat down to choose the first workstream we wanted to automate, we went a different direction. We chose launches.

Why? Because almost every PMM has a complicated relationship with launches. Most of us have done at least one that didn't go the way we planned. They're painful, they're time-pressured, and they never seem to have enough runway.

A launch starts with the product team and ends with the outbound team. When we looked at that path, we found three weak spots:

- Invisible brief quality
- Broken handoffs
- No single source of truth

So, we built a chain of agents to cover that whole path.

## The four agents behind our launches

We call it the launch signal chain. Four hero agents sit at the center of it. I named them Scout, Sentinel, Blueprint, and Playbook. Let me show you how they work.

cross_cutting.content:
# Manual Focus introduces Rider Panel to simulate cycling product launches

Sheffield-based marketing consultancy Manual Focus has introduced the Rider Panel, a research tool designed to help cycling brands test product launch plans using simulated customers.

Available through the consultancy’s Light Meter research tool, the Rider Panel runs a proposed launch through a simulated season, then repeats the exercise with one variable changed, such as price or sales channel. Manual Focus says a study takes days rather than months, with panels for other countries or products available on request.

How the Rider Panel works

Each AI agent is built from more than 40 details about a fictional person’s life, which are developed into a life story. One of the first 500, Philippa Hallam, is a simulated 55-year-old architect who has reduced her working week to three days, shares major purchasing decisions with her husband and has waited ten years to ride the Fred Whitton.

The agents decide month by month whether to buy, explaining their reasoning. Manual Focus says the panel can draw from a potentially limitless pool, with just five agents able to end a season in 4.7 billion different ways.

“Asking real customers is slow and expensive, so most brands only do it for their biggest launches and decide everything else on instinct,” said James Vickers, founder of Manual Focus. “With the Rider Panel, a brand can change the price or channel, run the same season again and see what that one change does before it commits the budget. You’d then take the best plans to real customers.”

The first study

For its first demonstration, Manual Focus tested a fictional folding smart trainer, branded Northfold, with 500 simulated UK cyclists looking for an indoor trainer that season. Rival products were real, using UK retailer prices checked on 28 October 2026.

Launch plan | Buyers of 500 
---|---
£399 for Black Friday | 41 
Named by AI engines | 33 
£499 with independent reviews | 26 
£499 without independent reviews | 3 

Manual Focus describes the drop in simulated purchases without independent reviews and the Black Friday gain as clear results. The increase associated with being named by AI engines was within the margin of error, with full ranges published in the report.

The results have not been compared with real sales. Manual Focus says it has registered forecasts for Black Friday 2026 and will publish the scores in December. The panel also narrowly missed two of its pass marks, with every check included in the report.

The full report is at manual-focus.co.uk/reports/rider-panel/. Studies are priced on application, with details at manual-focus.co.uk/rider-panel/.

Simulation settings and industry background

The simulation caps a new brand’s first-season reach at the awareness of JetBlack, an established UK challenger. This baseline is a model setting, not a survey result. Manual Focus added the cap after the full runs: before it was applied, the £399 price added 5% to revenue; afterwards, it added 38%. The report explains how the setting was established.

Founder James Vickers has worked with Wahoo and Wattbike, was on the founding team at RGT Cycling and contracts for Ribble Cycles. Manual Focus works with endurance sports and cycling brands.

Their first step was setting up Product Analytics and Session Replay, to see where people got stuck in the product.
cross_cutting.content:
# How Runable builds an agent for small business owners and tracks everything in PostHog

Runable is an AI platform that turns natural language prompts into apps, websites, pitch decks, ad campaigns, and more. The company recently closed a $21M Series A – momentum that’s reflected in their product data sent to PostHog: event volume surged from 317k in August 2025 to 40M in August 2026.

Most of Runable's users are small business owners who want to leverage AI without setting up agents or API keys. "Almost 80% of the world still doesn’t use agents," says Eshaan Pawan, Head of Growth. "Because it's hard."

When Runable started in mid-2025, no one knew what a general-purpose agent should look like. "Last year, it was still pretty new to anyone outside the AI sphere," says Ankit Kumar, an SDE at Runable. With no playbook to copy, the team had to learn from how people actually used it.

Their first step was setting up Product Analytics and Session Replay, to see where people got stuck in the product. Error Tracking and Logs followed for debugging, then Feature Flags to safely roll out new features.

For Ankit, LLM traces in AI Observability were the big win. "The main feature in Runable is the agent run – how the agent is responding to user messages," he says. His team needs to see where runs get stuck in order to set engineering priorities. In addition to using the default AIO dashboard to track cost, latency, tokens, and error rate across models, features, and users, they build a dashboard for each failure mode, fix the worst issues first, then focus on cutting token use and tuning caching.

<OSQuote customer="runable" author="ankit_kumar" quote={0} />

## Testing big changes with small rollouts

In February, Runable tried a pricing page that built a custom plan around each user's use case instead of offering four or five fixed ones. It went out behind a feature flag to 10 to 20% of users, and the data showed it hurt conversion.

"We noticed that users found the UI a bit confusing," Ankit says. About six weeks in, they scrapped it. "That decision was totally dependent on feature flags and event tracking in PostHog." Since only a slice of users ever saw it, there was no announcement to walk back and no flood of complaints – just a flag to turn off.

That's how most things ship at Runable, which has 39 flags live in production right now. A new model that's better for one kind of user can be worse for another, so the team doesn't ship everything to everyone at once. They split their ICP into personas such as freelancers, social media creators, and first-timers. Traces and events show what each segment is prompting for, so new features go out behind flags to the group they suit best.

The growth team uses flags too, for dynamic pricing and credits. An agent sets them up, then Eshaan checks the logic in the PostHog Web UI. "It's directly impacting the product," he says. "I can't leave it to the agent completely."

## A refreshing use of dashboards

At his last company, Eshaan worked with 40 to 50 people whose whole job was tying acquisition data to retention and product analytics. At Runable, he does the same work with a team of two. "Ankit set up the product metrics and I set up the acquisition metrics," he says. "And that's it. That's our team." He puts that down to having one source of truth: "It has really helped us cut down the number of people required."

Eshaan is a power user of both AI and UI. He might actually be the heaviest dashboard user we've met, with over 500 insight tiles and about 100 he checks four or five times a day. "I'm the guy who's just refreshing all the dashboards every hour," he says. "I'm using it like people use Databricks plus Tableau."

He didn't build them by hand. First, he connected 13 sources to Runable's Context Warehouse, including Stripe, six ad platforms, AppsFlyer, Dub, and the Google Sheets where he logs influencer campaigns. Then he pointed the Runable agent at the PostHog API, with his own config and skills, and had it build the insights.

The result is the whole funnel in one place: impression → page view → sign-up → first prompt → first artifact → free credit limit → paid, broken down by source, country, and device. PostHog also sends his conversion events straight to Google Ads and Meta, so he no longer needs Google Tag Manager.

<OSQuote customer="runable" author="eshaan_pawan" quote={0} />

The rest of Runable's team also uses both the Web UI and agents. 71 people have used PostHog in the last six months (about 30 of them daily), some clicking through insights and some asking an agent to pull the numbers. In the last month alone, their agents made 7,562 tool calls from Claude Code, Codex, and Runable itself. Two thirds were SQL, the rest mostly Logs and Error Tracking: ranking issues by how many users they hit, and pulling exception payloads to find the failing method.

## Session Replay monthly marathon

When the numbers can't explain something, Eshaan watches user behavior directly in Session Replay. Once or twice a month, he blocks off a day to binge recordings. "You're just obsessed with the problem," he says. "If you're not able to get it through data, you have to go and look at the session and see what's wrong."

Ankit's team uses replays the same way, to spot where people get stuck or confused in the UI. That's about to matter even more as Runable rebuilds its whole website (new UI, new internal structure) and moves its agents to a new sandbox provider.

Both will ship the way everything else does at Runable: tested behind flags, watched in replays, and measured on dashboards. It's a setup that covers acquisition, product, retention, and costs, all without a data team. So what would happen if PostHog disappeared tomorrow?

"It would set me back by, like, a month," Eshaan says. "Everything is integrated with PostHog."

<OSQuote customer="runable" author="eshaan_pawan" quote={1} />
